The whitenose whipray or Bleeker's whipray (Himantura uarnacoides) is a species of stingray in the family Dasyatidae native to the eastern Indian Ocean and the western central Pacific Ocean, where it is found in shallow water including estuaries.

species.name: Kucing tandang
species.summary: Kucing tandang (Prionailurus planiceps) adalah kucing liar kecil yang tersebar di Semenanjung Thailand-Melayu, Kalimantan dan Sumatra. Sejak 2008, telah terdaftar sebagai terancam punah oleh IUCN karena perusakan lahan basah di habitatnya.

The Aceh bulbul (Pycnonotus snouckaerti) is a species of songbird in the bulbul family of passerine birds. It is found in the mountains of north-western Sumatra and is endemic to the island. Its natural habitat is tropical moist lowland forest.

species.name: Babi bagong
species.summary: Babi kutil atau babi bagong (Sus verrucosus) adalah salah satu spesies babi liar yang menyebar terbatas (endemik) di Pulau Jawa dan Bawean. Dulu juga dijumpai di Pulau Madura, tetapi sekarang sudah punah. Spesies ini adalah hewan berkuku genap dalam keluarga Suidae.
Syntripsa flavichela is a species of freshwater crab found in Lake Towuti and Lake Mahalona on the Indonesian island of Sulawesi.

Acropora globiceps is a species of acroporid coral found in the oceanic central and western Pacific Ocean and central Indo-Pacific. It can also be found in the Great Barrier Reef, the Philippines, the Andaman Islands, Polynesia, Micronesia and the Pitcairn Islands.

Acropora lokani is a species of acroporid coral that was first described by C. C. Wallace in 1994. Found in marine, shallow reefs and sheltered lagoons, it occurs at depths between 8 and 25 m (26 and 82 ft). It is listed as vulnerable on the IUCN Red List, and is believed to have a decreasing population.

Anacropora spinosa is a species of briar coral that can be found in the central Indo-Pacific, Southeast Asia, the Solomon Islands, Japan, the East China Sea and the oceanic west Pacific Ocean. It is also found in Rodrigues and the Andaman Islands. It occurs in shallow reefs, from depths of 5–15 m.
The grey crowned crane (Balearica regulorum) is a bird in the crane family Gruidae. It is found in eastern and southern Africa, and is the national bird of Uganda.

Katak kepala-pipih kalimantan (Barbourula kalimantanensis) adalah sejenis kodok dari suku Bombinatoridae. Katak yang langka ini merupakan satu-satunya jenis katak di dunia yang diketahui tidak memiliki paru-paru; meskipun ketiadaan paru-paru ini juga ditemui pada beberapa jenis amfibi lainnya seperti pada salamander da…

Betta patoti, sometimes known as the tiger betta or zebra betta, is a species of gourami. It is a freshwater fish native to Asia, where it occurs in the southern part of East Kalimantan on the island of Borneo in Indonesia.

Betta schalleri, sometimes known as Schaller's mouthbrooder, is a species of gourami. It is a freshwater fish native to Asia, where it is known only from Bangka Island in Indonesia. It is typically found in hillstreams and peat swamp forests.

species.name: Anjing ajag
species.habitat: Dholes inhabit a wide range of habitats including tropical and subtropical forests, dry deciduous forests, evergreen forests, scrublands, and alpine meadows. They show high adaptability but require substantial prey populations and connected forest landscapes for pack territories.
species.summary: The dhole, also known as the Asiatic wild dog, is a highly social canid native to South and Southeast Asia, distinguished by its reddish coat and cooperative pack-hunting behavior. It is one of the most endangered large carnivores in Asia, facing severe habitat loss and prey depletion.

species.name: Musang air
species.summary: Musang air (Cynogale bennettii) adalah sejenis musang semi-akuatik yang ditemukan di hutan, terutama di dataran rendah, daerah dekat sungai dan lahan berawa-rawa.

species.name: Poksai sumatra
species.summary: The Sumatran laughingthrush (Garrulax bicolor), also known as the black-and-white laughingthrush, is a member of the family Leiothrichidae. It is endemic to highland forest on the Indonesian island of Sumatra, where it is threatened by habitat loss and capture for the wildlife trade.
Haliotis discus, commonly called disk abalone, is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Haliotidae, the abalones.
Harpesaurus modiglianii, also known commonly as Modigliani's nose-horned lizard, is a species of lizard in the family Agamidae. The species is endemic to Indonesia.

Holothuria (Microthele) fuscogilva, also known as the white teatfish or white teeth, is a species of sea cucumber in the genus Holothuria, subgenus Microthele. The cucumber is found in the tropical waters of the Indo-Pacific ocean. The species is vulnerable to over-exploitation from commercial fishing.

Owa kelempiau utara (Hylobates funereus), adalah sejenis kera arboreal yang termasuk ke dalam suku Hylobatidae. Nama lainnya adalah owa abu kalimantan, dan nama lokalnya di antaranya adalah uwa-uwa (Mly.).:243 Dalam bahasa Inggris ia disebut Northern Gray Gibbon atau East Bornean Gray Gibbon.

species.name: Owa bilau
species.summary: Owa bilau, bilou, owa bilou atau owa mentawai (Hylobates klossii) adalah suatu jenis kera unik yang mirip dengan siamang, namun kerdil dan menyebar terbatas (endemik) di Kepulauan Mentawai, Sumatera Barat. Sekujur tubuh bilou jantan, betina dan anak dipenuhi oleh rambut berwarna hitam.
Leptobrachella marmorata is a species of frog in the family Megophryidae. It occurs near the border of Indonesia and Malaysia on Borneo.
Limnonectes cintalubang is a species of fanged frogs in the family Dicroglossidae. It is endemic to western Sarawak, Malaysia. It is closely related to Limnonectes hikidai.
Maculabatis macrura is a species of stingray in the family Dasyatidae.

Mauremys reevesii, commonly known as the Chinese pond turtle, the Chinese three-keeled pond turtle, or Reeves' turtle, is a species of turtle in the family Geoemydidae, a family which was formerly called Bataguridae. The species is endemic to Asia.

The long-tailed Talaud mosaic-tailed rat or the long-tailed Talaud melomys (Melomys talaudium) is a species of rodent in the family Muridae. It is endemic to Karakelong and Salebabu in the Talaud Islands in Indonesia where it occurs in forest habitats.

Millepora dichotoma, the net fire coral, is a species of hydrozoan, consisting of a colony of polyps with a calcareous skeleton. Part of the metabolism of the fire coral relies on zooxanthellae included in their anatomy. They are found from the Red Sea to Samoa and South Africa.

Mugilogobius adeia is a species of goby endemic to Lake Matano on the Indonesian island of Sulawesi where it inhabits areas with a number of shells of the gastropod Tylomelania gemmifera in which it seeks shelter. This species can reach a length of 4.3 centimetres (1.7 in) TL.

The smalltooth sand tiger or bumpytail ragged-tooth (Odontaspis ferox) is a species of mackerel shark in the family Odontaspididae, with a patchy but worldwide distribution in tropical and warm temperate waters.

Oreophryne monticola is a species of frog in the Microhylidae family. It is endemic to Indonesia. Its natural habitat is subtropical or tropical moist montane forests. It is threatened by habitat loss.
The Bonthain tiger (Parantica sulewattan) is a species of nymphalid butterfly in the Danainae subfamily. It is endemic to Sulawesi, Indonesia.

The roughnose stingray, Pastinachus solocirostris, is a little-known species of stingray in the family Dasyatidae, generally found in shallow, estuarine waters associated with mangroves off Borneo, Sumatra, and possibly Java.

Lutung kutai (Presbytis canicrus) adalah spesies monyet yang juga merupakan hewan endemik di Kalimantan Timur, Pulau Kalimantan, Indonesia. Ia adalah salah satu primata paling terancam punah di dunia, dan pernah dianggap punah, hingga ditemukan kembali pada tahun 2012.

images.credit: Simon Fraser University Public Affairs and Media Relations

species.summary: The flapnose ray or Javanese cownose ray (Rhinoptera javanica) is a species of fish in the Rhinopteridae family.

species.name: Siluk kalimantan
species.summary: Arwana Asia (Scleropages formosus), atau Siluk Merah adalah salah satu spesies ikan air tawar dari Asia Tenggara. Arwana Asia memiliki badan yang panjang; sirip dubur yang terletak jauh di belakang badan. Ikan Arwana Asia adalah ikan bertulang dari keluarga Osteoglossidae, yang juga dikenal sebagai bonytongues.
Sphenomorphus sarasinorum is a species of skink found in Indonesia.
Sphenomorphus tropidonotus is a species of skink found in Indonesia.
Tarsius niemitz atau Bunsing, adalah salah satu species tarsius yang teridentifikasi pada tahun 2019 berasal dari Kepulauan Togian, Teluk Tomini, Sulawesi Tengah.
The southern giant clam, Tridacna derasa, is a species of extremely large marine clam in the cockle family, Cardiidae.
Tylomelania gemmifera is a species of freshwater snail with an operculum, an aquatic gastropod mollusk in the family Pachychilidae.
Tylomelania patriarchalis is a species of freshwater snail with an operculum, an aquatic gastropod mollusk in the family Pachychilidae.

species.name: Codot talaud
species.habitat: Primary and secondary tropical lowland rainforest on small oceanic islands. It likely uses forest interior for roosting and foraging, with some use of forest edge and fruiting trees in disturbed areas. The island ecosystem offers limited habitat extent by nature.
species.summary: Kalong talaud (Acerodon humilis) adalah sebuah spesies codot pada famili Pteropodidae. Spesies ini endemik ke Pulau Salibabu dan Karakelang, di Kepulauan Talaud, Indonesia. Habitat alaminya adalah rawa-rawa subtropis atau tropis.

The sterlet (Acipenser ruthenus) is a relatively small species of sturgeon from Eurasia native to large rivers that flow into the Black Sea, Azov Sea, and Caspian Sea, as well as rivers in Siberia as far east as Yenisei. Populations migrating between fresh and salt water (anadromous) have been extirpated.

Acropora hemprichii is a species of acroporid coral that was first described by Christian Gottfried Ehrenberg in 1834. Found in shallow reefs in marine environments, this species occurs at depths of 3 to 15 m (9.8 to 49.2 ft), and lives for between 13 and 24 years.

Acropora verweyi is a species of acroporid coral found in the southwest and northern Indian Ocean, the central Indo-Pacific, Australia, southeast Asia, Japan, the East China Sea and the oceanic western Pacific Ocean. It is also found in the Philippines, American Samoa, Fiji and Rodrigues.

Panda merah (Ailurus fulgens) adalah sejenis binatang menyusui di dalam ordo Carnivora. Sesuai namanya, Panda merah memiliki bulu tebal berwarna merah kecokelatan dan berkaki hitam. Mukanya berbentuk bulat berwarna putih dengan garis merah kecokelatan dari mata ke mulutnya.

The lilac-crowned amazon (Amazona finschi) is a parrot endemic to the Pacific slopes of Mexico. Also known as Finsch's amazon, the parrot is characterized by green plumage, a maroon forehead, and violet-blue crown.

The yellow-headed amazon (Amazona oratrix), also known as the yellow-headed parrot and double yellow-headed amazon, is an endangered amazon parrot of Mexico and northern Central America. Measuring 38–43 centimetres (15–17 in) in length, it is a stocky short-tailed green parrot with a yellow head.

Bayan matahari (Aratinga solstitialis) adalah sebuah spesies bayan berbulu cerah yang berasal dari Amerika Selatan timur laut. Jantan dan betina dewasa tampaknya mirip, dengan paruh hitam, bulu yang sebagian besar kuning keemasan, perut dan muka oranye, dan ekor serta sayap berujung hijau dan biru.

The Indian hog deer (Hyelaphus porcinus) is a small deer whose habitat ranges from Pakistan, through northern India, to mainland southeast Asia, which inhabits much of the Indo-Gangetic Plains of Pakistan, northern India, Nepal, Bangladesh, southwestern Yunnan Province in China, all the way to western Thailand.
aliases: 3 subspecies endangered: Indochina Hog Deer (Axis porcinus annamiticus)
Bawean Deer or Kuhl's Deer (Axis porcinus kuhli)
Calamianes Deer or Philippine Deer (Axis porcinus calamianensis); A. kuhli and A. porcinus (CR-IUCN)
species.listing: EN-US FWS: A. p. annamiticus - June 14, 1976, A. p. kuhli - June 2, 1970, A. p. calamianensis - June 14, 1976 EN-IUCN: 2015

species.summary: Betta albimarginata is a species of betta endemic to the island of Borneo, where it is only found in the Indonesian province of Kalimantan Timur. It inhabits the shallows (5 to 10 cm (2.0 to 3.9 in)) of forest streams amongst vegetation and debris along the shores. This species grows to a length of 2.8 cm (1.1 in).

Betta antoni is a species of gourami endemic to the Sanggau area in the Kapuas region. The species name antoni is named after Irwan Anton "in recognition of his generous help and gift of specimens". This species grows to a length of 8 centimetres (3.1 in) SL.

Betta foerschi is a species of gourami endemic to the island of Borneo, where it is only known from the southern portion. It inhabits creeks in the rain forest. This species grows to a length of 7 cm (2.8 in). It can be found in the aquarium trade.
Betta mandor adalah salah satu spesies ikan cupang. Betta mandor adalah ikan air tawar yang ditemukan di rawa-rawa, sungai serta sungai di hutan Kalimantan Indonesia.

Betta persephone is a species of gourami endemic to Malaysia where it is only known from Johor. This betta's specific epithet derives from the Greek goddess Persephone, queen of the Underworld, a reference to the largely blackish colouration of this fish.

species.habitat: Inhabits primary montane and submontane tropical forest with dense understory and thick leaf litter, often near streams. It appears to favor cool, humid forest conditions typical of Sulawesi's central highlands.
species.summary: Bunomys coelestis is a little-known murid rodent endemic to the high-altitude forests of central Sulawesi. It belongs to a radiation of Bunomys species that diversified across the mountainous, biogeographically isolated island.

Unta baktria (Camelus bactrianus) adalah mamalia berkuku genap yang asli dari stepa-stepa di Asia Tengah (kawasan Baktria). Spesies unta ini mempunyai dua punuk pada punggungnya, berbeda dengan unta arab (C. dromedarius) yang berpunuk satu.

species.name: Kucing merah
species.habitat: Primarily found in dense lowland tropical rainforest, including primary and some secondary forest; also recorded near limestone outcrops and riverine forest. It appears to avoid heavily disturbed or open habitats, showing strong dependence on continuous forest cover.
species.summary: The Borneo Bay Cat is a small, elusive wild cat endemic to the island of Borneo, making it one of the least-known and rarest felids in the world. It is a forest specialist found exclusively in lowland tropical rainforest and is rarely observed by scientists or locals.

The varied white-fronted capuchin (Cebus versicolor) is a species of gracile capuchin monkey from Colombia. It had been classified as a subspecies of the white-fronted capuchin (C. albifrons) Genetic analysis by Jean Boubli in 2012 revealed it to be a separate species.

Celetaia persculpta, sometimes referred to as blue turbo snail or freshwater turbo sail, is a species of freshwater snail with a gill and an operculum, in the "river snail" family Viviparidae. They are endemic to Lake Poso on Sulawesi, preferring fine substrate, which they dig and sift through to find food. C.
The African spurred tortoise (Centrochelys sulcata), also called the sulcata tortoise, is a species of tortoise inhabiting the southern edge of the Sahara desert in Africa.

Hasselt's bamboo shark (Chiloscyllium hasseltii) is a bamboo shark in the family Hemiscylliidae found around Thailand, Malaysia and Indonesia, between latitudes 23° N and 10° N, and longitude 91° E and 133° E; residing inshore. Its length is up to 60 cm.

species.habitat: Found along clear, fast-flowing rocky streams and rivers within lowland to montane tropical rainforest; requires well-oxygenated, unpolluted water and dense riparian vegetation cover.
species.summary: Chimarrogale phaeura, the Bornean Water Shrew, is a small semi-aquatic shrew endemic to the island of Borneo. It inhabits clear, fast-flowing montane and hill streams within primary tropical rainforest. Its remarkable adaptation to an aquatic lifestyle among shrews makes it a rare and specialized insectivore.

The rhinoceros iguana (Cyclura cornuta) is a threatened species of lizard in the family Iguanidae that is primarily found on the Caribbean island of Hispaniola, shared by the Republic of Haiti and the Dominican Republic.
The speckle-faced bent-toed gecko (Cyrtodactylus psarops) is a species of gecko that is endemic to southern Sumatra.
Danio erythromicron, often known as emerald dwarf rasbora, is a species of cyprinid fish which is endemic to Inle Lake in Myanmar.
Eremiascincus butlerorum is a species of skink found in Sumba in Indonesia.

The roughback whipray (Himantura kittipongi) is a rare species of freshwater stingray in the family Dasyatidae, found over sandy bottoms in the Mae Klong and Chao Phraya Rivers of Thailand. Growing no more than 29 cm (11 in) across, this small ray has an oval pectoral fin disc and a whip-like tail without fin folds.

The marbled whipray (Fluvitrygon oxyrhynchus) is a little-known species of stingray in the family Dasyatidae, native to several freshwater rivers in Southeast Asia. This species has an oval pectoral fin disc with an elongated, pointed snout and a very long, whip-like tail without fin folds.

The black pond turtle (Geoclemys hamiltonii ), also known as the spotted pond turtle or the Indian spotted turtle, is a species of turtle endemic to South Asia. It belongs to the monotypic genus Geoclemys.
The reticulated giraffe (Giraffa reticulata or Giraffa camelopardalis reticulata) is a species/subspecies of giraffe native to the Horn of Africa.

The wood turtle (Glyptemys insculpta) is a species of turtle endemic to North America. It is in the genus Glyptemys, a genus which contains only one other species of turtle: the bog turtle (Glyptemys muhlenbergii ).

The Indonesian houndshark (Hemitriakis indroyonoi) is a species of houndshark in the genus Hemitriakis. It is a tropical houndshark, known from the eastern Indonesian islands of Bali and Lombok, in the Indian Ocean. It was described by William T. White, Leonard J.V. Compagno, and Dharmadi in 2009.

Kuda nil kerdil (Choeropsis liberiensis atau Hexaprotodon liberiensis) adalah hewan sejenis kuda nil yang berhabitat di rawa-rawa dan belantara Afrika Barat utamanya di Liberia. Populasi kecil kuda nil kerdil juga terdapat di Sierra Leone, Guinea, hingga Pantai Gading.

The American plaice or sole (Hippoglossoides platessoides) is a North Atlantic flatfish that belongs, along with other right-eyed flounders, to the Pleuronectidae family. In the northwest Atlantic (H. p. platessoides) it ranges from Greenland and Labrador to Rhode Island, and in the northeast Atlantic (H. p.
Sorensen's leaf-nosed bat (Hipposideros sorenseni) is a species of bat in the family Hipposideridae endemic to Indonesia.

Holothuria (Microthele) whitmaei, commonly known as the black teatfish, is a species of sea cucumber in the family Holothuriidae. The sea cucumber is distributed in the western Indian and Pacific oceans, with specimens being found off of Tanzania, New Caledonia and the Philippines.
The Hewitson's small tree-nymph (Ideopsis hewitsonii) is a species of nymphalid butterfly in the Danainae subfamily. It is endemic to New Guinea (Indonesia).

The Mentawi flying squirrel (Iomys sipora) is a species of rodent in the family Sciuridae. It is endemic to Indonesia where it is only known from the Mentawai Islands (Sipura and North Pagai). Its natural habitat is lowland tropical primary forest below 500 m (1,600 ft) above sea level.

Isostichopus badionotus, also known as the chocolate chip cucumber or the cookie dough sea cucumber, is a species of sea cucumber in the family Stichopodidae. This common species is found in warm parts of the Atlantic Ocean.

The West Usambara two-horned chameleon or West Usambara blade-horned chameleon (Kinyongia multituberculata) is a chameleon endemic to the West Usambara Mountains of Tanzania. Until 2008, it was generally confused with Fischer's chameleon (K. fischeri), which is not found in the Usambara Mountains.
The Borneo broadfin shark (Lamiopsis tephrodes) is a species of requiem shark, and part of the family Carcharhinidae.

The ring-tailed lemur (Lemur catta) is a large strepsirrhine primate and the most recognized lemur due to its long, black and white ringed tail. It belongs to Lemuridae, one of five lemur families, and is the only member of the Lemur genus. Like all lemurs it is endemic to the island of Madagascar.
Tamarin singa kepala-emas (Leontopithecus chrysomelas), atau yang juga dikenal sebagai tamarin kepala-emas, adalah sebuah spesies tamarin singa yang endemik ke Brasil.
Leptomantis malkmusi is a species of frog in the family Rhacophoridae. It is endemic to Malaysia, where it has been observed between 500 and 1000 meters above sea level.

The Aral barbel (Luciobarbus brachycephalus) is a species of ray-finned fish in the genus Luciobarbus. It is found in the Aral basin, Chu drainage and southern and western Caspian Sea. For spawning, it migrates up to larger tributaries of the western and southern coasts.

species.name: Berang-berang gunung
species.summary: Berang-berang sumatra (Lutra sumatrana) atau berang-berang saja adalah mamalia semiakuatik endemik di Asia Tenggara. Hewan ini merupakan salah satu spesies berang-berang yang paling langka dan paling tidak dikenal. Keberadaannya terancam oleh hilangnya sumber daya alam dan perburuan liar.

Beruk siberut atau bokkoi (Macaca siberu) adalah sebuah spesies makaka genting, yang endemik ke Pulau Siberut di Indonesia. Sebelumnya, spesies ini dianggap konspesifik dengan beruk mentawai (M. pagensis) yang bulunya lebih pucat secara keseluruhan, namun susunan ini polifiletik.

Makaka ekor-singa (Macaca silenus, dikenal sebagai സിംഹവാലൻ കുരങ്ങ് dalam bahasa Malayalam), atau wanderoo, adalah sebuah endemik monyet Dunia Lama. Hewan tersebut berada di Ghat Barat, India Selatan.

The alligator snapping turtle (Macrochelys temminckii) is a species of turtle in the family Chelydridae, native to freshwater habitats in the United States. M. temminckii is one of the heaviest freshwater turtles in the world.

The golden hamster, or Syrian hamster (Mesocricetus auratus) is a member of the subfamily Cricetinae, the hamsters. In the wild, they are now considered vulnerable. Their natural geographical range is limited to northern Syria and southern Turkey, in arid habitats.

The micro frog or Cape Flats frog (Microbatrachella capensis) is a species of frog less than 2 cm (0.8 in) long in the Pyxicephalidae family, in the monotypic genus Microbatrachella. Its colour varies from rufous brown with dark mottling, to tan or green, depending on the population.

Mugilogobius latifrons is a species of goby endemic to the Malili Lake system (consisting of Matano, Towuti and smaller lakes) in central Sulawesi, Indonesia generally being found in extremely shallow waters. This species can reach a length of 4.7 centimetres (1.9 in) TL.

Ungka pipi-bungalan utara (Nomascus annamensis) adalah sebuah spesies ungka jambul yang baru dideskripsikan dan ditemukan di Vietnam, Kamboja, dan Laos. Habitatnya berada di hutan subtropis basah dan tropis musiman yang lembap di negara-negara tersebut.

Orbicella annularis, commonly known as the boulder star coral, is a species of coral that lives in the western Atlantic Ocean and is the most thoroughly studied and most abundant species of reef-building coral in the Caribbean to date. It also has a comprehensive fossil record within the Caribbean.

Oreophryne rookmaakeri is a species of frog in the Microhylidae family. It is endemic to Indonesia. Its natural habitats are subtropical or tropical dry forests and subtropical or tropical dry shrubland.

Kelinci domestik atau yang lebih umum dikenal dengan kependekkannya yakni kelinci adalah berbagai jenis kelinci Eropa yang dijinakkan. Kelinci domestik digunakan sebagai sumber pangan dan wol, subyek penelitian, dan sebagai hewan peliharaan. Kelinci jantan disebut bucks; betina disebut does.

Oriks simitar (Oryx dammah) adalah sebuah spesies Oryx yang dulunya tersebar luas di Afrika Utara. Spesies ini punah di alam liar pada tahun 2000, tetapi sebuah kelompok dilepaskan ke dalam kandang aklimasi di dalam Cagar Alam fauna Ouadi Rimé-Ouadi pada tahun 2016, kemudian diperkenalkan kembali ke alam liar.

The common chimpanzee (Pan troglodytes), also known as the robust chimpanzee, is a species of great ape. Colloquially, the common chimpanzee is often called the chimpanzee (or "chimp"), though this term can be used to refer to both species in the genus Pan: the common chimpanzee and the closely related bonobo, formerly…
Papilio lampsacus is a species of swallowtail butterfly from the genus Papilio that is found in west Java, Indonesia. It is very rare, and there are few recently confirmed sightings.

Parosphromenus filamentosus, also known as the spiketail gourami or the filament licorice gourami, is a species of gourami. It is native to Asia, where it is known only from freshwater habitats in southeastern Borneo. The species reaches 4.0 cm (1.6 in) in standard length and is known to be a facultative air-breather.
Pastinachus gracilicaudus, the narrow cowtail ray, is a type of cowtail ray patchily found in Indo-Malay Archipelago. It lives in the continental insular shelves of up to 60 m depth.

species.name: Kuskus gebe
species.summary: Kuskus Gebe (Phalanger alexandrae) adalah jenis kuskus dari spesies marsupialia dalam keluarga Phalangeridae. Hewan ini adalah endemik dari Pulau Gebe di Maluku Utara, Indonesia. Tempat tinggal Kuskus Gebe berada di ketinggian 300 meter dari permukaan laut.
Philautus cornutus is a species of frog in the family Rhacophoridae. It is endemic to Indonesia.

Potamotrygon tigrina, also known as the tiger river stingray, is a species of freshwater ray in the family Potamotrygonidae. This endangered species is endemic to black- and whitewater rivers in the upper Amazon basin in northeastern Peru.

Langur-uban sabah (Presbytis sabana), juga dikenal sebagai langur-uban saban, adalah sebuah spesies monyet dalam famili Cercopithecidae. Sebelumnya, lutung ini dianggap sebagai subspesies dari lutung banggat, Presbytis hosei (sebagai Presbytis hosei sabana).
Nuri abu-abu afrika (Psittacus erithacus), atau yang juga dikenal sebagai beo abu-abu afrika, nuri abu-abu kongo, dan nuri kelabu, adalah sebuah spesies bayan Afrika dalam famili Psittacidae.

The smoky flying squirrel (Pteromyscus pulverulentus) is a species of rodents in the family Sciuridae. It is monotypic within the genus Pteromyscus. It is found in Brunei, Indonesia, Peninsular Malaysia, and southern Thailand, but its range may be more extensive than currently mapped.

The little soft-furred rat (Rattus mollicomulus) is a species of rodent in the family Muridae. It is found only on the upper slopes of Mount Lampobattang in Bantaeng Regency, South Sulawesi, Indonesia. It is so called because it of soft silky fur. It is smaller than the roof rat but larger than house mouse.

The Denison barb, Denison's barb, Miss Kerala, red-line torpedo barb, or roseline shark (Dawkinsia denisonii) is an endangered species of cyprinid fish endemic to the fast-flowing hill streams and rivers of the Western Ghats in India.

Seriatopora stellata is a species of colonial stony coral in the family Pocilloporidae. It is native to the western Indo-Pacific region, its range extending from the central Indian Ocean to the central Indo-Pacific, northwestern Australia, Indonesia, Japan, the south China Sea and the oceanic island groups in the West…

The red siskin (Spinus cucullatus) is a small passerine bird. This finch is a resident breeding bird in tropical South America in northern Colombia and northern Venezuela (where it's called "cardenalito"). The introduced population on Trinidad is believed to be extinct, with no sightings since 1960.

species.name: Tapir tenuk
species.habitat: Dense lowland tropical rainforest, swamp forest, and hilly forest areas with access to rivers or water sources for cooling and escape from predators. Prefers areas with dense understory vegetation for cover and foraging.
species.summary: Tapir Asia (Tapirus indicus) adalah salah satu jenis tapir. Tapir asia merupakan jenis yang terbesar dari keempat jenis tapir dan satu-satunya yang berasal dari Asia. Nama ilmiahnya indicus merujuk pada Hindia Timur, yaitu habitat alami jenis ini.

species.name: Krabuku kecil
species.summary: Krabuku kerdil atau Tangkasi gunung, adalah sebuah primata nokturnal yang ditemukan di Sulawesi Tengah, Indonesia, di kawasan dengan keragaman spesies yang vegetatif rendah ketimbang hutan tropis dataran rendah.

Lutung celak (Trachypithecus obscurus) adalah spesies primata dalam famili Cercopithecidae. Monyet ini ditemukan di Semenanjung Malaysia, Myanmar, dan Thailand, dan terkadang dapat ditemukan di Singapura.
Tropidonophis punctiventris the Halmahera keelback, is a species of colubrid snake. It is found in Indonesia.
Tylomelania carbo is a species of freshwater snail with an operculum, an aquatic gastropod mollusk in the family Pachychilidae.
Tylomelania centaurus is a species of freshwater snail with an operculum, an aquatic gastropod mollusk in the family Pachychilidae.
Tylomelania toradjarum is a species of freshwater snail with an operculum, an aquatic gastropod mollusk in the family Pachychilidae.
Unio crassus, the thick shelled river mussel, is a species of freshwater mussel, an aquatic bivalve mollusk in the family Unionidae, the river mussels.

species.name: Biawak banggai
species.summary: The quince monitor (Varanus melinus) is a species of monitor lizards endemic to Indonesia. It is very closely related to the mangrove monitor (Varanus indicus), with both belonging to the subgenus Euprepiosaurus.

species.name: Julang sulawesi
species.summary: Julang sulawesi (Rhyticeros cassidix) adalah spesies burung rangkong dalam famili Bucerotidae yang endemik di Sulawesi. Bagi masyarakat Sulawesi, setidaknya terdapat tiga nama lokal untuk menyebut jenis burung ini yaitu Allo, Taong, dan Lupi.

species.name: Penyu lekang
species.summary: Penyu Lekang (Lepidochelys olivacea), disebut juga olive ridley sea turtle dalam bahasa Inggris merupakan spesies penyu yang hidup di perairan tropis dan subtropis yang berperairan dangkal. Penyu lekang ditemukan bertelur di Samudra Hindia, Samudra Pasifik, dan pantai di pulau-pulau besar.

species.name: Julang emas
species.summary: Julang emas (bahasa Latin: Rhyticeros undulatus) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Bucerotidae, dari genus Rhyticeros. Burung ini merupakan jenis burung pemakan buah-buahan, Ficus, kepiting, kodok yang memiliki habitat di hutan dataran rendah, perbukitan. tersebar sampai ketinggian 2.000 m dpl.

species.name: Enggang cula
species.summary: The rhinoceros hornbill (Buceros rhinoceros) is a large species of forest hornbill (Bucerotidae). In captivity it can live for up to 35 years.

species.name: Kangkareng sulawesi
species.summary: Kangkareng Sulawesi (Rhabdotorrhinus exarhatus) adalah spesies burung rangkong dalam famili Bucerotidae. Burung ini endemik di Pulau Sulawesi dan pulau-pulau satelitnya (Lembeh, Muna, dan Butung). Burung ini berukuran lebih kecil dibandingkan jenis Kangkareng di Indonesia, panjang tubuhnya sekitar 45 cm.

species.name: Cerek Besar
species.summary: Cerek besar (bahasa Latin = Pluvialis squatarola) adalah spesies burung dari famili Charadriidae, dari genus Pluvialis. Burung ini merupakan jenis burung pemakan invertebrata yang memiliki habitat di gosong lumpur dan pasir di daerah pasang surut.

species.name: Cica-Kopi Melayu
species.summary: Cica-kopi melayu ( Pomatorhinus bornensis ) adalah spesies burung dalam keluarga Timaliidae . Ia endemik di Sumatera, Kalimantan, dan Malaysia . Cica-kopi melayu dan cica-kopi Jawa dikelompokkan sebagai cica-kopi punggung-merah .

species.name: Cikalang christmas
species.summary: Cikalang christmas (Fregata andrewsi) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Fregatidae, dari genus Fregata. Burung ini merupakan jenis burung pemakan ikan dan bagian tubuh binatang lain, hidup atau mati yang memiliki habitat di laut, pantai. Burung ini hidup endemis di Pulau Natal, Samudra Hindia.

species.name: Betet ekor-panjang
species.summary: The long-tailed parakeet (Psittacula longicauda) is a parakeet endemic to the regions of Andaman and Nicobar islands, Sumatra, Borneo and Peninsular Malaysia (including Singapore).

species.name: Kuau raja
species.summary: Kuau raja (Argusianus argus) adalah salah satu burung yang terdapat di dalam suku Phasianidae. Kuau Raja mempunyai bulu berwarna cokelat kemerahan dan kulit kepala berwarna biru. Burung jantan dewasa berukuran sangat besar, panjangnya dapat mencapai 200 cm.

species.name: Kedidi Golgol
species.summary: The curlew sandpiper (Calidris ferruginea) is a small wader that breeds on the tundra of Arctic Siberia. The genus name is from Ancient Greek kalidris or skalidris, a term used by Aristotle for some grey-coloured waterside birds.

species.name: Luntur jawa
species.summary: The Javan trogon (Apalharpactes reinwardtii) is a species of bird in the family Trogonidae. The species was once lumped together with the Sumatran trogon in a single species, the blue-tailed trogon, but differences in size, weight, and plumage have led to the two being split.

species.name: Kangkareng hitam
species.summary: The black hornbill (Anthracoceros malayanus) is a species of bird of the hornbill family Bucerotidae. It lives in Asia in Brunei Darussalam, Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand.

species.name: Kerak Kerbau
species.summary: Kerak kerbau (Acridotheres javanicus) atau juga dikenal sebagai jalak kebo, jalak hitam, jalak ungu, dan jalak penyu adalah spesies burung yang merupakan termasuk familia jalak. Burung ini menyebar luas di Asia Timur, Asia Tenggara dan Kepulauan Indonesia bagian barat.

species.name: Paus sperma
species.summary: Koteklema, paus sperma (bahasa Inggris: sperm whale), atau paus kepala kotak (Physeter macrocephalus) adalah hewan terbesar dalam kelompok paus bergigi sekaligus hewan bergigi terbesar di dunia.

species.name: Rusa timor
species.summary: Rusa Jawa atau sambar Sunda (Rusa timorensis) adalah jenis rusa yang endemik di wilayah pulau Jawa, Bali dan Timor (termasuk Timor Leste) di Indonesia.

species.name: Sempidan Jambul Sumatra
species.summary: The Malayan crested fireback or Malay crested fireback (Lophura rufa) is a species of forest pheasant found in lowland forests of the Thai-Malay Peninsula and Sumatra.

species.name: Kedidi Ekor-Tajam
species.summary: The sharp-tailed sandpiper (Calidris acuminata) (but see below) is a small wader.

species.name: Lutung budeng
species.summary: Lutung budeng (Trachypithecus auratus) adalah sejenis lutung yang rambutnya berwarna hitam legam. Monyet anggota suku Cercopithecidae ini menyebar terbatas (endemik) di Indonesia bagian barat.

species.name: Walik rawa-manu
species.summary: Walik rawamanu atau walik rawa-manu (Ptilinopus dohertyi) adalah spesies burung dalam keluarga Columbidae. Burung ini endemik (menyebar terbatas) di Pulau Sumba. Dalam bahasa Inggris dikenal sebagai Red-naped fruit-dove (merpati buah bertengkuk merah).
The whitetip reef shark (Triaenodon obesus) is a species of requiem shark, in the family Carcharhinidae, and the only member of its genus.

The Flores green pigeon (Treron floris) is a species of bird in the family Columbidae. It is endemic to the Lesser Sunda Islands of Indonesia and occur on the islands Lombok, Sumbawa, Flores, Solor, Lembata, Pantar and Alor.

species.name: Puyuh-Gonggong Biasa
species.summary: The grey-breasted partridge (Arborophila orientalis), also known as the white-faced hill partridge, or Horsfield's hill partridge, is a species of bird in the Phasianidae family.

The blacktip reef shark (Carcharhinus melanopterus) is a species of requiem shark, in the family Carcharhinidae, easily identified by the prominent black tips on its fins (especially on the first dorsal fin and its caudal fin).

species.name: Lutung kedih
species.summary: Kedih (Presbytis thomasi) adalah spesies primata yang tergolong dalam famili Cercopithecidae. Hewan ini merupakan hewan endemik di utara Sumatra, Indonesia. Habitat alaminya adalah hutan tropis kering atau subtropis. Hewan ini terancam oleh pengrusakan habitat. Nama aslinya adalah reungkah di Aceh dan kedih di Alas.
The spiny seahorse (Hippocampus histrix), also referred to as the thorny seahorse, is a marine fish belonging to the family Syngnathidae, native from the Indo-Pacific area.

Tuna mata besar (Thunnus obesus) adalah spesies ikan dari golongan tuna sejati dari genus Thunnus, dan termasuk familia Skombride. Ikan ini adalah ikan konsumsi tangkapan penting dalam industri perikanan ataupun sebagai target penangkapan ikan rekreasi.

The humpback grouper (Cromileptes altivelis), also known as the panther grouper, (in Australia) barramundi cod, (in the Philippines, in Tagalog) lapu-lapung senorita, (in the Philippines, in Bisayan) miro-miro, (in Japan) sarasa-hata, (in India) kalava, and many other local names, is a species of marine ray-finned fish…

Hippocampus kuda, also known as the estuary seahorse, yellow seahorse or spotted seahorse is a seahorse of the family Syngnathidae native to the Indo-Pacific. The common name sea pony has been used for this species under its synonym Hippocampus fuscus.

species.name: Walik benjol
species.summary: The carunculated fruit dove (Ptilinopus granulifrons) is a species of bird in the family Columbidae. It is endemic to Obira.

species.name: Gosong maluku
species.summary: Gosong maluku (Eulipoa wallacei) adalah sejenis burung gosong berukuran kecil, dengan panjang sekitar 31 cm, dan merupakan satu-satunya spesies di dalam genus tunggal Eulipoa.

species.name: Paruh-Kodok Besar
species.summary: The large frogmouth (Batrachostomus auritus) is a species of bird in the family Podargidae. It is found in Brunei, Indonesia, Malaysia, and Thailand, in subtropical or tropical moist lowland forest.
The green humphead parrotfish (Bolbometopon muricatum) is the largest species of parrotfish, growing to lengths of 1.3 m (4.3 ft) and weighing up to 46 kg (101 lb).

species.name: Puyuh Sengayan
species.summary: Puyuh sengayan atau dalam nama ilmiahnya Rollulus rouloul adalah sejenis burung puyuh berukuran kecil, dengan panjang sekitar 25 cm, berkaki dan kulit sekitar mata berwarna merah. Burung jantan dan betina mudah dibedakan.

species.name: Cendrawasih elok
species.summary: Penghisap-madu Elok adalah sejenis burung penghisap madu khas daerah Papua, Indonesia. Spesies ini ditemukan di daerah ketinggian pegunungan Jayawijaya pada ketinggian 2.700 sampai 4.000 meter.

species.name: Pelatuk kelabu-besar
species.summary: The great slaty woodpecker (Mulleripicus pulverulentus) is a species of bird in the family Picidae. It is found across the Indian Subcontinent and Southeast Asia. A unique and basically unmistakable bird, it is the largest species of woodpecker that is certain to exist today. It is a fairly gregarious species.

species.name: Dara laut aleutian
species.summary: The Aleutian tern (Onychoprion aleuticus, formerly Sterna aleutica) is a seabird in the family Laridae. The genus name is from Ancient Greek onux, "claw", and "prion", nail. The specific aleuticus refers to the Aleutian Islands.

Acropora granulosa is a species of acroporid coral found in the northern and southwest Indian Ocean, the Red Sea, Australia, the East China Sea, Japan, the oceanic central and western Pacific Ocean, and the central Indo-Pacific.

Tarsius spektral Gursky (Tarsius spectrumgurskyae) atau Tangkasi, Wusing adalah spesies tarsius yang ditemukan di pulau Sulawesi di Indonesia. Revisi taksonomi baru-baru ini, memisahkan spesies ini dari tarsius tarsier dan spesies tarsius lainnya berdasarkan perbedaan vokalisasi dan pelase.

species.name: Punai Bakau
species.summary: The cinnamon-headed green pigeon (Treron fulvicollis) is a species of bird in the family Columbidae. It is found in Brunei, Indonesia, Malaysia, Myanmar, Singapore, and Thailand.

species.name: Rajawali papua
species.summary: Rajawali papua (Harpyopsis novaeguineae) merupakan salah satu jenis Burung elang dari famili Accipitridae, yang berada dalam subfamili Harpiinae dan genus Harpyopsis.

species.name: Cucak Delima
species.summary: The ruby-throated bulbul (Pycnonotus dispar), or yellow bulbul, is a member of the bulbul family of passerine birds. It is found on Sumatra, Java, and Bali.

species.name: Bunglon Hutan Kuhl
species.summary: Gonocephalus kuhlii is a species of lizard in the family Agamidae. The species is native to Indonesia.

species.name: Lutung kelabu
species.summary: Lutung Kelabu atau dalam nama ilmiahnya Trachypithecus cristatus adalah sejenis lutung berukuran sedang, dengan panjang sekitar 58cm. Lutung Kelabu memiliki rambut tubuh berwarna hitam dengan ujung warna putih atau kelabu.

species.name: Kuskus-beruang Sulawesi
species.summary: Kuskus Beruang adalah anggota dari genus Ailurops. Kuskus Beruang adalah hewan marsupial dan dari keluarga Phalangeridae.

species.name: Penyu belimbing
species.summary: Penyu belimbing (Dermochelys coriacea) adalah sejenis penyu raksasa dan satu-satunya jenis dari suku Dermochelyidae yang masih hidup. Penyu ini merupakan penyu terbesar di dunia dan merupakan reptil keempat terbesar di dunia setelah tiga jenis buaya.

species.name: Berkik-gunung maluku
species.summary: The Moluccan woodcock (Scolopax rochussenii), also known as Obi woodcock, is a medium-sized, approximately 40 cm long, forest wader with long and dark bill, orange buff below and black barred upperparts. The plumage is marked with large buff spots.

Trachyrhamphus bicoarctatus, also known as the double-ended pipefish is a species of marine fish belonging to the family Syngnathidae . They can be found in reefs, seagrass beds, and sandy habitats throughout the Indo-Pacific from East Africa to New Caledonia and from Japan to Australia .

species.name: Cabak kolong
species.summary: Bonaparte's nightjar (Caprimulgus concretus), juga dikenal sebagai Sunda nightjar, adalah sebuah spesies burung Cabak (keluarga Caprimulgidae). Spesies tersebut ditemukan di pulau-pulau Sumatra, Belitung dan Kalimantan. Habitat alaminya adalah hutan dataran rendah bahasa subtropis atau tropis.

species.name: Kedidi Paruh-Lebar
species.summary: The broad-billed sandpiper (Calidris falcinellus) is a small wading bird. The scientific name is from Latin. The specific name falcinella is from falx, falcis, "a sickle. Some research suggests that it should rather go into the genus Philomachus.

The bigeye thresher (Alopias superciliosus) is a species of thresher shark, family Alopiidae, found in temperate and tropical oceans worldwide. Like other thresher sharks, nearly half its total length consists of the elongated upper lobe of the tail fin.

species.name: Burung madu sangihe
species.summary: Burung-madu sangihe (Aethopyga duyvenbodei) adalah salah satu jenis burung yang dilindungi oleh undang undang.Burung ini merupakan endemik Sulawesi. Burung ini juga pernah dianggap sebagai burung terlangka di kawasan Wallacea. Burung ini sulit terlihat, terutama saat memakan madu di tajuk pohon yang tinggi.

The yellow rasbora (Rasbora lateristriata) is a species of ray-finned fish in the genus Rasbora from Southeast Asia. It is a primarily freshwater fish originally from Java island in Indonesia. It is known as the Wader pari fish in the Indonesian language.

species.name: Kuskus scham-scham
species.summary: Kuskus waigeo atau kuskus-tutul waigeo (Spilocuscus papuensis) adalah spesies marsupial dari famili Phalangeridae. Kuskus waigeo adalah hewan endemik dari Pulau Waigeo, sehingga dinamakan sebagai kuskus waigeo.
Kerapu macan (Epinephelus fuscoguttatus) adalah sejenis kerapu yang menghuni perairan Indo-Pasifik. Bersama-sama dengan kerapu kertang, ikan ini merupakan ikan tangkap yang populer di Nusantara.

species.name: Empuloh paruh-kait
species.summary: The hook-billed bulbul (Setornis criniger) is a species of songbird in the bulbul family, Pycnonotidae. It is found in eastern Sumatra and Borneo, where its natural habitats are subtropical or tropical moist lowland forests and subtropical or tropical swamps. It is threatened by habitat loss.

species.name: Enggang papan
species.summary: Rangkong papan atau dalam nama ilmiahnya Buceros bicornis adalah spesies terbesar dalam suku burung Bucerotidae. Burung dewasa berukuran sangat besar, dengan panjang mencapai 160cm. Burung ini memiliki bulu berwarna hitam, dan tanduk kuning-hitam di atas paruh besar berwarna kuning.

species.name: Bubut jawa
species.summary: Bubut jawa (Centropus nigrorufus) adalah spesies keluarga tekukur, bubut, dan sejenisnya pada familia Cuculidae. Hewan ini endemik di Indonesia.

species.name: Elang wallace
species.summary: Elang wallace atau dalam nama ilmiahnya Nisaetus nanus adalah elang yang dapat kita temui di hutan hutan Kalimantan, dan Sumatra di Indonesia. Juga dapat kita temui di selatan Thailand dan Malaysia. Namun, ia jarang ditemukan di hutan dataran rendah Kalimantan.

species.name: Tiong-Batu Kalimantan
species.summary: Tiong-batu kalimantan (pityriasis gymnocephala) adalah satu-satunya anggota dari keluarga burung pengicau Pityriaseidae dan genus Pityriasis. Ia merupakan spesies misterius dan jarang dijumpai dari kanopi hutan hujan Kalimantan.

species.name: Gosong tanimbar
species.summary: The Tanimbar megapode or Tanimbar scrubfowl (Megapodius tenimberensis) is a small megapode endemic to the Tanimbar Islands of Indonesia. It is sometimes considered to be a subspecies of the orange-footed scrubfowl, Megapodius reinwardt.

species.name: Ciung-mungkal jawa
species.summary: Ciung-mungkal jawa (Cochoa azurea) adalah spesies burung yang termasuk famili Turdidae. Burung ini adalah burung endemik Indonesia.

species.name: Kasturi ternate
species.summary: The chattering lory (Lorius garrulus) is a forest-dwelling parrot endemic to North Maluku, Indonesia. It is considered vulnerable, the main threat being from trapping for the cage-bird trade.

The Alor myzomela (Myzomela prawiradilagae) is a species of bird in the family Meliphagidae, the honeyeaters. It is endemic to the Indonesian island of Alor, where it is the only representative member of the genus Myzomela.

species.name: Mambruk ubiaat
species.summary: Mambruk ubiaat dalam nama ilmiahnya Goura cristata, juga dikenal dengan nama Mambruk barat, Mambruk biasa atau Mambruk mahkota-biru, Goura cristata, adalah salah satu spesies burung Mambruk atau Dara mahkota yang merupakan kerabat merpati.Burung berwarna biru keabu-abuan ini berukuran cukup besar dengan ciri khas mahko…

species.name: Punai Besar
species.summary: The large green pigeon (Treron capellei) is a species of bird in the family Columbidae. It is found in Brunei, Indonesia, Malaysia, Myanmar, and Thailand. Its natural habitat is subtropical or tropical moist lowland forests. It is threatened by habitat loss.

species.name: Lutung surili
species.summary: Surili jawa (Presbytis comata) adalah spesies monyet Dunia Lama terancam yang endemik pada sebagian pulau Jawa, Indonesia. Hewan ini menyukai hutan primer dan penghuni pohon (arboreal).

Acropora caroliniana is a species of acroporid coral that was first described by Nemenzo in 1976. Found in tropical, shallow reef slopes, it occurs at depths of 5 to 25 m (16 to 82 ft) in a marine environment. The species is rated as vulnerable on the IUCN Red List, with a decreasing population.

species.name: Gosong sula
species.summary: Gosong sula atau kailong (Megapodius bernsteinii), adalah spesies burung dari famili Megapodiidae. Burung ini hanya dapat ditemukan di Indonesia, dengan habitat pada hutan subtropikal atau hutan tropis, hutan dataran rendah subtropis atau tropis, hutan mangrove subtropis atau tropis, dan dataran dengan tumbuhan perdu b…

species.name: Walik Jambu
species.summary: The jambu fruit dove (Ptilinopus jambu) is a smallish colourful fruit dove. It is a resident breeding species in southern Thailand, Malaysia, Brunei and the Indonesian islands of Kalimantan, Sumatra and Java. It is a monotypic species.

Seriatopora hystrix is a species of colonial stony coral in the family Pocilloporidae. It forms a bushy clump and is commonly known as thin birdsnest coral. It grows in shallow water on fore-reef slopes or in sheltered lagoons, the type locality being the Red Sea.

species.name: Kareo talaud
species.summary: Kareo talaud (Amaurornis magnirostris) adalah spesies burung dalam famili Rallidae. Burung ini endemik di Kepulauan Talaud, Sulawesi Utara. Ditemukan pada bulan Agustus 1996, hingga kini diketahui hanya hidup di Pulau Karakelong.

species.name: Sempidan kalimantan
species.summary: Sempidan kalimantan (Lophura bulweri) atau dikenal juga dengan nama Burung Pakiak (Kalimantan Barat) atau Beleang Bulwor adalah burung dari Asia Tenggara dalam keluarga Phasianidae, endemik hutan rimba pulau Kalimantan. Saat ini terdaftar sebagai Rentan oleh IUCN.

species.name: Linne, 1758 nautilus berongga
species.summary: Nautilus berongga (Nautilus pompilius) atau nautilus bilik (semuanya terjemahan dari chambered nautilus) adalah spesies nautilus yang paling diketahui. Cangkangnya, bila dipotong, akan memperlihatkan gewang berkilau dan spiral logaritmik yang hampir sempurna, meski bukan spiral emas.
Whitehead's spiny rat (Maxomys whiteheadi) is a species of rodent in the family Muridae. It is found in Indonesia, Malaysia, and Thailand.

The southern sunfish (Mola alexandrini), also known as the Ramsay's sunfish, southern ocean sunfish, short sunfish or bump-head sunfish in many parts of the world, is a fish belonging to the family Molidae.

species.name: Bubut teragop
species.summary: The short-toed coucal (Centropus rectunguis) is a species of cuckoo in the Cuculidae family. It is found in Brunei, Indonesia, Malaysia, and Thailand. Its natural habitats are subtropical or tropical moist lowland forests and subtropical or tropical moist shrubland. It is threatened by habitat loss.

The hedgehog seahorse (Hippocampus spinosissimus) is a species of fish in the family Syngnathidae. It is found in Australia, Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Singapore, Sri Lanka, Taiwan, Thailand, and Vietnam. Its natural habitat is coral reefs. It is threatened by habitat loss.

species.name: Tokhtor Sunda
species.summary: The Bornean ground cuckoo (Carpococcyx radiceus) is a large terrestrial species of cuckoo in the Cuculidae family. It is, as suggested by its common name, endemic to the island of Borneo, being found in the sections belonging to Brunei, Malaysia and Indonesia. It is restricted to humid forest.

Chrysiptera hemicyanea, known commonly as the azure damselfish, azure demoiselle, half-blue demoiselle, and yellow-dipped damsel, is a species of damselfish. It is native to the eastern Indian Ocean and western Pacific. It has also recently been found in the central Mediterranean, in the waters around Sicily and Malta.

The orange spotted filefish or harlequin filefish, Oxymonacanthus longirostris, is a filefish in the family Monacanthidae found on coral reefs in the Indo-Pacific Oceans. The orangespotted filefish is a different species and refers to Cantherhines pullus.

species.name: Ketam kenari
species.summary: Ketam kenari atau ketam kelapa (Birgus latro) merupakan artropoda darat terbesar di dunia. Meskipun disebut ketam atau kepiting, hewan ini bukanlah kepiting. Ketam ini merupakan jenis umang-umang yang sangat maju dalam hal evolusi.

The invisible rail, Wallace's rail, or drummer rail (Habroptila wallacii) is a large flightless rail that is endemic to the island of Halmahera in North Maluku, Indonesia, where it inhabits impenetrable sago swamps adjacent to forests.

species.name: Kacamata Biasa Jawa (Sangkar)
species.summary: The Sangkar white-eye (Zosterops melanurus) is a bird species in the family Zosteropidae. It is also known as the Sunda white-eye. It is found on the Indonesian islands of Java and Bali. It lives in forest, in Java it is typically found in altitudes from 200–1,600 m (660–5,250 ft), and sometimes lower than that.

species.name: Penyu bromo
species.summary: Penyu tempayan adalah salah satu jenis penyu yang penyebarannya sangat luas meliputi Samudera Hindia, Samudera Pasifik, Samudera Mediterania dan Samudera Atlantik.

species.name: Beruang madu
species.habitat: Primarily lowland tropical and subtropical moist forests, including primary and secondary rainforests. Also found in swamp forests and montane forests up to certain elevations, favoring areas with dense canopy cover.
species.summary: Beruang madu (Helarctos malayanus) termasuk familia Ursidae dan merupakan jenis paling kecil dari kedelapan jenis beruang yang ada di dunia. Beruang ini adalah fauna khas provinsi Bengkulu sekaligus dipakai sebagai simbol dari provinsi tersebut. Beruang madu juga merupakan maskot dari kota Balikpapan.

species.name: Monyet boti
species.summary: Macaca tonkeana (juga disebut dengan monyet hitam jambul, monyet tonkean, atau monyet boti) merupakan spesies primata endemik yang dilindungi di Sulawesi, terutama di Sulawesi Tengah dan Kepulauan Togean.

species.name: Lutung merah
species.summary: Lutung merah (Presbytis rubicunda) adalah spesies primata di dalam keluarga Cercopithecidae. Keberadaan lutung merah dapat ditemukan di Kalimantan dan Kepulauan Karimata. Lutung merah memiliki ekor panjang dan memiliki bulu berwarna kemerahan, wajah berulas kebiruan.

Acropora jacquelineae is a species of acroporid coral found in the eastern Indian Ocean and the central and western Pacific Ocean. It can be found offshore of Indonesia, Malaysia, Papua New Guinea, the Samoan Islands, and the Solomon Islands.

species.name: Cekakak Cina
species.summary: Cekakak tiongkok (Halcyon pileata) adalah spesies burung dalam famili Halcyonidae. Burung ini tersebar dari India ke timur sampai Tiongkok, Korea dan Taiwan, serta ke selatan sampai Kepulauan Andaman dan Nicobar, Myanmar, Laos dan Hainan.

species.name: Kima tapak kuda
species.summary: The bear paw clam, also known as the horse's hoof clam or strawberry clam, Hippopus hippopus, is a species of large saltwater clam, a tropical marine bivalve mollusk in the family Tridacnidae, the giant clam family.

species.name: Nuri kabare
species.summary: Nuri kabare (Psittrichas fulgidus) atau juga disebut nuri elang, atau nuri nazar (sehingga mudah dibedakan dengan Pyrilia vulturina dari Brasil), adalah anggota dari genusnya (Psittrichas), dan genusnya sendiri merupakan anggota sendiri dari subfamilia Psittrichadinae.

species.name: Babi berjenggot
species.summary: Babi berjenggot (Sus barbatus) atau babi janggut, adalah sejenis babi liar (babi hutan) yang menyebar di Semenanjung Malaya, Sumatra, Kalimantan, dan Kepulauan Sulu. Babi palawan (S. ahaenobarbus) sebelumnya dimasukkan sebagai anak jenis babi berjenggot, tetapi kini dianggap sebagai spesies tersendiri.

species.name: Puyuh Hitam
species.summary: The black partridge (Melanoperdix niger), also known as the black wood partridge, is a small (up to 27 cm long) partridge with a thick bill, grey legs and dark brown iris. It is the only member of the monotypic genus Melanoperdix.

The squaretail coral grouper (Plectropomus areolatus) is a species of marine ray-finned fish. It is a grouper from the subfamily Epinephelinae, which is part of the family Serranidae. This family also includes anthias and sea basses.

species.name: Luntur putri
species.summary: The cinnamon-rumped trogon (Harpactes orrhophaeus) is a species of bird in the family Trogonidae.

species.name: Kuntul cina
species.summary: Kuntul cina (Egretta eulophotes) adalah sejenis spesies kuntul terancam dari Asia bagian timur. Spesies tersebut pertama kali dideskripsikan oleh Robert Swinhoe pada 1860.

species.name: Bulus
species.summary: The Asiatic softshell turtle or black-rayed softshell turtle (Amyda cartilaginea) is a species of softshell turtle in the Trionychidae family. It is not the only softshell turtle in Asia (most trionychines are Asian).

species.name: Dihe
species.summary: Monyet dige (Macaca hecki), atau yang juga dikenal sebagai dihe, bankalae, atau makaka heck, adalah sebuah spesies monyet makaka dari Sulawesi, Indonesia. Monyet Dunia Lama ini adalah hewan diurnal.

species.name: Beiyogo
species.summary: The Malayan flat-shelled turtle (Notochelys platynota) is a species of turtle found in Southeast Asia.

Jangilus atau layaran indo-pasifik (Istiophorus platypterus) adalah sejenis ikan layaran asli Samudra Hindia dan Pasifik, serta telah diperkenalkan ke wilayah Atlantik. Ikan ini telah memasuki perairan Laut Tengah melalui Terusan Suez.

species.name: Celepuk flores
species.summary: Celepuk flores (Otus alfredi) adalah jenis burung hantu dari famili Strigidae. Penemuan pertama atas celepuk flores pada tahun 1896 di Gunung Repok, Pulau Flores. Celepuk flores merupakan endemik Flores. Keberadaan celepuk flores tidak ditemukan lagi hingga Maret 1994.

species.name: Percil Bali
species.summary: Percil bali (Microhyla orientalis) adalah sejenis kodok bertubuh kecil dari suku Microhylidae. Kodok yang baru dikenali pada 2013 ini sejauh ini baru tercatat keberadaannya di Pulau Bali.

species.name: Berencet kalimantan
species.summary: Berencet kalimantan (bahasa Latin: Ptilocichla leucogrammica) adalah salah satu spesies burung di dalam keluarga Timaliidae. Dapat ditemukan di Brunei, Indonesia, dan Malaysia. Habitat alaminya adalah hutan dataran rendah lembap subtropis atau tropis dan rawa subtropis atau tropis.
Lutung budeng barat (Trachypithecus mauritius) atau lutung budeng (sebelum dianggap sebagai spesiesnya sendiri) adalah sebuah spesies monyet dunia lama dari subfamili Colobinae.

Acropora desalwii is a species of acroporid coral that was first described by Dr Carden Wallace in 1994. Found in sheltered, tropical, shallow reefs, mainly on the slopes, this species is generally found at depths below 15 metres (49 feet), but this can be as low as 30 metres (98 feet).
Eutropis macrophthalma is a species of skink found in Sulawesi.

species.name: Babirusa Sulawesi
species.habitat: Primarily found in dense lowland tropical rainforest, riverine forest, and swampy areas, often close to rivers, lakes, or coastal wetlands. It prefers areas with abundant fruit trees and mud wallows for thermoregulation and parasite control.
species.summary: Babirusa sulawesi utara (Babyrousa celebensis) adalah babirusa yang berasal dari Sulawesi dan beberapa pulau terdekat (Lembeh, Buton dan Muna) di Indonesia. Spesies ini memiliki dua pasang gading besar yang terdiri dari gigi taring yang besar. Gigi taring atas menembus bagian atas moncong, melengkung kembali ke dahi.

species.name: Mandar dengkur
species.summary: Mandar dengkur (bahasa Latin: Aramidopsis plateni, bahasa Inggris: snoring rail, Celebes rail, Platen's rail) adalah burung Rallidae besar tak terbang dan merupakan satu-satunya anggota dari genus Aramidopsis.

Caridina caerulea is a freshwater shrimp from Sulawesi. It is one of 11 species in the genus Caridina that is endemic to Lake Poso. It lives on a variety of substrates, including wood, rocks, sand and macrophytes. It is suspected only to live in shallow water.

Cephalopachus bancanus, krabuku ingkat, mentilin, atau pelilean merupakan salah satu spesies krabuku. Primata endemik Sumatra dan Kalimantan, Indonesia ini berdasarkan keputusan menteri dalam negeri (Kepmendagri) nomor 522.53-958/2010 ditetapkan sebagai fauna identitas provinsi Bangka Belitung.

species.name: Mujair
species.summary: Mujair adalah sejenis ikan air tawar yang biasa dikonsumsi. Penyebaran alami ikan ini adalah perairan Afrika dan di Indonesia pertama kali ditemukan oleh Pak Mujair di muara Sungai Serang pantai selatan Blitar, Jawa Timur pada tahun 1939.

species.name: Sikatan Biru-Langit
species.summary: The Sunda blue flycatcher (Cyornis caerulatus), also known as the large-billed blue-flycatcher, is a species of bird in the family Muscicapidae. It is found in Brunei, Indonesia, and Malaysia. Its natural habitat is subtropical or tropical moist lowland forests. It is threatened by habitat loss.

species.name: Ceret taliabu
species.summary: The Taliabu bush warbler (Locustella portenta) is a species of Old World warbler in the family Locustellidae. It is endemic to the island regency of Taliabu in Indonesia.

species.name: Pedan jawa
species.summary: The Javan slit-faced bat (Nycteris javanica) is a species of slit-faced bats found on the Kangean Islands of Indonesia and Nusa Penida, Java. This species is also located in West Timor. This species' population is decreasing....
The magou (Euploea magou) is a species of nymphalid butterfly in the Danainae subfamily. It is endemic to Indonesia.

Caridina ensifera is a freshwater shrimp from Sulawesi. It is one of the 11 species of Caridina endemic to Lake Poso. It lives on a variety of substrates, including wood, rocks, sand and macrophytes, but is also found in pelagic swarms. It is suspected to only live in shallow water.
Papilio neumoegeni is a species of butterfly in the family Papilionidae. It is endemic to the islands of Sumba in Indonesia.

images.credit: Yale Peabody Museum of Natural History; photo by Nicole M. Palffy-Muhoray 2019

species.name: Simpai
species.summary: Lutung mitra (Presbytis mitrata) adalah spesies monyet dalam famili Cercopithecidae. Sebelumnya dianggap sebagai subspesies surili Sumatera, Presbytis melalophos (sebagai Presbytis melalophos mitrata) tetapi analisis genetik mengungkapkan bahwa ini adalah spesies yang terpisah.

The round ribbontail ray (Taeniura meyeni) is a species of stingray in the family Dasyatidae, found throughout the nearshore waters of the tropical Indo-Pacific, as well as off islands in the eastern Pacific.

species.name: Binturong
species.habitat: Primarily found in dense tropical evergreen and semi-evergreen rainforests with continuous canopy cover, allowing arboreal movement. Also inhabits secondary forests, though less commonly, and requires large trees for denning and travel corridors.
species.summary: Binturung atau Binturong (Arctictis binturong ) adalah sejenis musang bertubuh besar, anggota suku Viverridae. Beberapa dialek Melayu menyebutnya binturong, menturung atau menturun. Dalam bahasa Inggris, hewan ini disebut Binturong, Malay Civet Cat, Asian Bearcat, Palawan Bearcat, atau secara ringkas Bearcat.
The silvertip shark (Carcharhinus albimarginatus) is a large species of requiem shark, in the family Carcharhinidae, with a fragmented distribution throughout the tropical Indian and Pacific Oceans.

species.name: Monyet digo
species.summary: Monyet digo atau monyet butung (nama ilmiah: Macaca ochreata) merupakan salah satu primata endemik Sulawesi yang tersebar di Sulawesi Tenggara. Monyet ini berukuran 50–59 cm ditambah ekor 35–40 cm. Monyet digo memiliki berat badan berbeda antara jantan dan betina. Hewan jantan memiliki berat 9–12 kg dan betina 5–7 kg.

Seriatopora caliendrum is a species of colonial stony coral in the family Pocilloporidae. It forms a bushy clump and is commonly known as the green birdsnest coral. It is native to East Africa, the Red Sea and the western Indo-Pacific region, the type locality being the Red Sea.

The silky shark (Carcharhinus falciformis), also known by numerous names such as blackspot shark, grey whaler shark, olive shark, ridgeback shark, sickle shark, sickle-shaped shark, and sickle silk shark, is a species of requiem shark, in the family Carcharhinidae, named for the smooth texture of its skin.

images.credit: Programa Marino del Golfo de California

species.summary: Caridina longidigita, also known as the Sulawesi fan shrimp, is a species of freshwater atyid shrimp.
The big-lip damselfish is a species of ray-finned fish from the family Pomacentridae, it is the only species in the monotypic genus Cheiloprion.

species.name: Melas harimau tutul/ macan tutul
species.summary: Macan tutul atau harimau bintang ( Panthera pardus ) adalah salah satu dari lima spesies yang masih ada dalam genus Panthera. Ia memiliki bulu pucat kekuningan hingga emas tua dengan bintik-bintik gelap yang membentuk pola seperti mawar .

Pavona cactus, the cactus coral, potato chip coral or leaf coral, is a species of colonial stony coral in the family Agariciidae. This coral is found in shallow waters on reefs and in lagoons in tropical parts of the Indo-Pacific region.

species.name: Rusa sambar
species.habitat: Sambar occupy a wide range of habitats including tropical dry and moist deciduous forests, evergreen forests, grasslands, and scrublands. They favor areas with dense cover near water sources and are highly adaptable to both lowland and hill forests.
species.summary: Rusa sambar atau sambar india (disebut juga rusa sambur, sambhur, Tamil: Kadaththi man), adalah jenis rusa besar yang umum berhabitat di Asia. Spesies yang umum memiliki ciri khas tubuh yang besar dengan warna bulu kecokelatan. Sambar dapat tumbuh setinggi 102 cm–160 cm sampai bahu dengan berat sekitar 546 kg.

species.name: Duyung
species.habitat: Shallow, warm coastal and inshore waters, especially seagrass beds in bays, mangrove channels, and the leeward sides of large islands. They avoid deep open ocean, preferring depths generally under 10 meters to access seagrass pastures.
species.summary: Duyung atau dugong (Dugong dugon) adalah sejenis mamalia laut yang merupakan salah satu anggota Sirenia atau sapi laut yang masih bertahan hidup selain manatee dan mampu mencapai usia 22 sampai 25 tahun. Duyung bukanlah ikan karena menyusui anaknya dan masih merupakan kerabat evolusi dari gajah.
Caridina sarasinorum is a species of freshwater atyid shrimp. It is one of eight Caridina species endemic to Lake Poso.

Weber's sailfin lizard (Hydrosaurus weberi), is an agamid lizard found in Indonesia. Specifically, it is endemic to Halmahera and Ternate Islands of Maluku. It has a life-span of between 10–15 years. H. weberi is the smallest of the three recognized species of Hydrosaurus, attaining an avg.

species.name: Monyet Dihe Sulawesi
species.summary: Monyet gorontalo, monyet-hitam gorontalo, dihe, atau monyet dumoga (Macaca nigrescens) adalah spesies primata dari keluarga Cercopithecidae. Monyet Dumoga merupakan hewan endemik dari Pulau Sulawesi, dengan penyebaran di Gorontalo, Indonesia.
Meristogenys jerboa is a species of frog in the Ranidae family. It is endemic to Malaysia.

species.name: Sanca bodo
species.summary: The Burmese python (Python bivittatus) is one of the five largest species of snakes in the world (about the third-largest as measured either by length or weight). It is native to a large area of tropical South and Southeast Asia.

species.name: Kalong Sulawesi
species.habitat: Primarily inhabits lowland and foothill primary tropical rainforests, but also uses secondary forests and forest edges. It requires large, undisturbed trees for roosting and relies on mature forest for food resources such as ripe figs and other forest fruits.
species.summary: Kalong sulawesi (Acerodon celebensis) adalah sebuah spesies codot yang endemik dari Indonesia. Spesies ini diklasifikasikan sebagai "Rentan" oleh IUCN karena tingkat perburuan yang tidak berkelanjutan.

Lobophyllia corymbosa, the lobed cactus coral or brain root coral, is a species of large polyp stony coral in the family Lobophylliidae. It occurs on reefs in shallow waters in the Red Sea, off the coast of East Africa, and in other parts of the tropical Indo-Pacific.

species.name: Sikatan-Rimba Coklat
species.summary: The brown-chested jungle flycatcher (Cyornis brunneatus) is a species of bird in the Old World flycatcher family Muscicapidae. It is found in Brunei, China, Hong Kong, Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, and Tibet.

Barbour's seahorse (Hippocampus barbouri) is a species of seahorse. It is found in Indonesia, Malaysia, and the Philippines. Its natural habitat is subtidal aquatic beds. It is threatened by habitat loss. It is often confused with the hedgehog seahorse, H. histrix.

species.name: Paok bidadari
species.summary: Paok bidadari (Pitta nympha) adalah spesies burung paok dalam famili Pittidae. Burung ini berbiak di Jepang, Korea, dan China timur. Pada musim dingin pindah keselatan sampai China selatan, Indocina, dan Kalimantan. Paok bidadari menuju ke selatan pada bulan Oktober sampai Maret, melewati Kalimantan.

Stichopus herrmanni, Herrmann's sea cucumber', is a species of echinoderm in the family Stichopodidae. It is found in the tropical, western Indo-Pacific Ocean, at depths down to 20 m (66 ft). This and several other species are known as curryfish and are harvested commercially; it is called gama in Indonesia.

Boleophthalmus pectinirostris, commonly known as the great blue spotted mudskipper, is a species of mudskipper native to the north-western Pacific Ocean. It can be found on the coastlines of Japan, eastern China, Sumatra, Malaysia, Taiwan and the Korean Peninsula.

species.name: Kangguru pohon nemena
species.summary: Unijo nemena adalah sejenis hewan berkantung dalam keluarga Macropodidae. Hewan ini merupakan hewan endemik di wilayah Semenanjung Doberai dan mungkin juga di semenanjung Fakfak di Papua Barat, Indonesia.
The camouflage grouper (Epinephelus polyphekadion) is a species of marine fish in the family Serranidae.
Lestes praevius is a species of spreadwing in the damselfly family Lestidae.

species.name: Sanca timor
species.summary: Python timoriensis is a python species found in South East Asia. A dwarf form, no subspecies are currently recognized. Like all pythons, they are nonvenomous constrictors; unlike larger species such as P. reticulatus, they are not considered dangerous to humans.

species.name: Labi-labi Cina
species.summary: The Chinese softshell turtle (Pelodiscus sinensis) is a species of softshell turtle that is endemic to China (Inner Mongolia to Hainan) and Taiwan, with records of escapees—some of which have established introduced populations—in a wide range of other Asian countries, as well as Spain, Brazil and Hawaii.

species.name: Kuskus matabiru
species.summary: Kuskus Mata Biru (Phalanger matabiru) adalah spesies dari marsupial dalam keluarga Phalangeridae. Hewan ini endemik dari dua pulau Tidore dan Ternate, dari Kepulauan Halmahera di Maluku Utara, Indonesia.

species.name: Posum Ekor-kait Arfak
species.summary: The Vogelkop ringtail possum (Pseudochirulus schlegeli) is a species of marsupial in the family Pseudocheiridae. It is endemic to the Vogelkop Peninsula, West Papua, Indonesia. It is threatened by habitat loss.

Rhacophorus monticola is a species of frog in the Rhacophoridae family endemic to Indonesia. Its natural habitats are subtropical or tropical moist montane forests and rivers. It is threatened by habitat loss.
Tarsius jatna, Krabuku gorontalo, Mimito atau Bumbulan (Tarsius supriatnai) adalah salah satu spesies krabuku yang habitatnya berada di wilayah Gorontalo, Indonesia.

species.name: Kalong Nusatenggara
species.habitat: Primary and secondary lowland tropical rainforest, montane forest up to moderate elevations, and forest edges adjacent to fruiting trees. Occasionally uses mangrove fringes and garden-forest mosaics near human settlements when natural habitat is degraded.
species.summary: The Sunda flying fox or Sunda fruit bat (Acerodon mackloti) is a species of bat in the family Pteropodidae. It is endemic to Indonesia.

species.name: Macan dahan
species.habitat: Primarily found in lowland and montane tropical rainforests, including primary and selectively logged secondary forests. Also inhabits peat swamp forests and mangrove areas in coastal regions of Borneo.
species.summary: The Sunda Clouded Leopard is a medium-sized wild cat endemic to the islands of Borneo and Sumatra, distinguished from the mainland clouded leopard by genetic and morphological differences. It is the largest predator on both islands, playing a crucial apex predator role in tropical rainforest ecosystems.

species.name: Krabuku diana
species.summary: Tarsius dian ( Tarsius dentatus ), juga dikenal sebagai ngasi atau krabuku diana, adalah primata nokturnal yang endemik di hutan hujan Sulawesi Tengah, Indonesia . Panjang kepala-tubuhnya 115–12 sentimeter (45,3–4,7 in) dan memiliki ekor sepanjang 22 sentimeter (8,7 in). Sebelumnya disebut T.

species.name: Kerak sulawesi
species.summary: Kerak sulawesi (Acridotheres cinereus) adalah spesies jalak-jalakan dari famili Sturnidae. Ia dapat ditemukan di Pulau Christmas, Indonesia, Malaysia, dan Singapura.

The spinner shark (Carcharhinus brevipinna) is a species of requiem shark, in the family Carcharhinidae, named for the spinning leaps it makes as a part of its feeding strategy. This species occurs in tropical and warm temperate waters worldwide, except for in the eastern Pacific Ocean.

species.name: Cucut tekeh
species.summary: The slender bamboo shark, Chiloscyllium indicum, is a bamboo shark in the family Hemiscylliidae found in the Indo-West Pacific Oceans between latitudes 40° N and 10° S, and longitude 65° E and 160° E. Its length is up to 65 cm.

species.name: Kangguru pohon wakera
species.summary: Unijo kelabu (endrolagus inustus) adalah spesies kecil arboreal dari marsupial dalam famili Macropodidae. Dapat ditemukan di hutan perbukitan Papua utara dan barat dan merupakan spesies asli untuk beberapa pulau lepas pantai.
The nurse shark (Ginglymostoma cirratum) is an elasmobranch fish within the family Ginglymostomatidae. They are directly targeted in some fisheries and considered as bycatch in others.
Montipora verrucosa is a stony coral Cnidarian found in the Pacific and Indian Oceans.

Sundadanio axelrodi is a danionin in the family Cyprinidae. Originally described as a rasbora, Rasbora axelrodi, this tiny species was later deemed to be more closely related to the danios but not enough to be moved into the genus Danio. Sundadanio axelrodi reaches a maximum size of 1.7 cm.
Actinopyga echinites, commonly known as the brown sea cucumber, or spiny sea cucumber, is a species of sea cucumber in the family Holothuriidae.
Betta coccina is a species of gourami native to Peninsular Malaysia and Sumatra, Indonesia. It grows to a length of 5.6 cm (2.2 in). It can be found in the aquarium trade.

species.name: Kambing hutan sumatera
species.summary: Kambing-hutan sumatra (Capricornis sumatraensis sumatraensis) adalah jenis kambing hutan yang hanya terdapat di hutan tropis pulau Sumatra. Populasinya sudah semakin terdesak akibat perambahan hutan secara liar. Spesies ini ditetapkan dalam daftar tumbuhan dan satwa dilindungi di Indonesia.

species.name: Hiu banteng
species.summary: The bull shark (Carcharhinus leucas), also known as the Zambezi shark or, unofficially, as Zambi in Africa and Lake Nicaragua shark in Nicaragua, is a requiem shark commonly found worldwide in warm, shallow waters along coasts and in rivers.

Ular-gua elok ( Elaphe taeniura ) atau ular pengantin adalah spesies ular dalam famili Colubridae . Spesies ini asli dari wilayah timur dan tenggara Asia. Ini adalah spesies ular semi- arboreal yang panjang dan tipis dengan beberapa subspesies yang diakui.

The sicklefin weasel shark (Hemigaleus microstoma) is an uncommon species of ground shark in the family Hemigaleidae. It is native to southern India, southern China, and parts of Southeast Asia, living in shallow waters down to a depth of 170 m (560 ft).
Hippocampus kelloggi atau juga dikenal sebagai kuda laut Kellogg adalah sebuah spesies ikan dalam keluarga Syngnathidae. Spesies tersebut adalah salah satu spesies terbesar dari 54 spesies kuda laut.
Lobocheilos falcifer is a species of cyprinid in the genus Lobocheilos. It inhabits Malaysia and Indonesia and has a maximum length of 33.5 centimetres (13.2 in).
The tawny nurse shark (Nebrius ferrugineus) is a species of carpet shark in the family Ginglymostomatidae, and the only extant member of the genus Nebrius.

The pink whipray (Himantura fai) is a species of stingray in the family Dasyatidae, with a wide but ill-defined distribution in the tropical Indo-Pacific from southern Africa to Polynesia. It is a bottom dweller that generally inhabits shallow water under 70 m (230 ft) deep, in sandy areas associated with coral reefs.

The Siberut flying squirrel (Petinomys lugens) is a species of rodent in the family Sciuridae. It is endemic to Indonesia. Its natural habitat is subtropical or tropical dry forests. It is threatened by habitat loss.
Actinopyga mauritiana, commonly known as the surf redfish, is a species of sea cucumber in the family Holothuriidae. It is native to the tropical West Indo-Pacific region and is harvested for food.

Betta simorum is a species of gourami endemic to Indonesia. This species grows to a length of 6.4 centimetres (2.5 in) SL. This species can also be found in the aquarium trade. The species was named simorum and uses the Latin genitive plural "of the Sims", named so in honour of Thomas G. K.
Glaucostegus atau pari kikir adalah genus ikan pari besar dari perairan Indo-Pasifik, kecuali satu spesies yakni Glaucostegus cemiculus yang hidup di perairan Atlantik Timur dan Mediterania.

Ecsenius randalli is a species of combtooth blenny in the genus Ecsenius. It is found the western central Pacific ocean, around Indonesia. It can reach a maximum length of 2 centimetres. Blennies in this species feed primarily off of plants, including benthic algae and weeds.
Ideopsis oberthurii is a species of nymphalid butterfly in the Danainae subfamily. It is endemic to Indonesia.

species.name: Ikan raja laut
species.summary: Coelacanth Indonesia (Latimeria menadoensis) (sering dikenal dengan ikan raja laut), atau juga disebut coelacanth Sulawesi, adalah salah satu dari dua spesies hidup coelacanth, sejenis ikan purba, yang masih ada hingga kini. Coelacanth Indonesia memiliki ciri berwarna sisik tubuh kecokelatan.

Setuhuk biru atlantik atau marlin biru atlantik (Makaira nigricans) adalah sebuah spesies marlin yang endemik ke Samudra Atlantik. Spesies ini berkerabat dekat dengan, dan umumnya dianggap konspesifik dengan, setuhuk biru indo-pasifik, dengan keduanya dikenal sebagai marlin biru.

Weber's dwarf squirrel (Prosciurillus weberi) is a species of rodent in the family Sciuridae. It is endemic to northern and western Sulawesi, Indonesia. Its natural habitat is subtropical or tropical dry forests.

species.name: Mandorman Ekor-gelang
species.summary: The reclusive ringtail possum (Pseudochirops coronatus) is a species of marsupial in the family Pseudocheiridae. It is endemic to the Arfak Mountains in the Vogelkop Peninsula of West Papua, Indonesia.

Kalong maluku (Pteropus chrysoproctus) adalah spesies kelelawar yang merupakan anggota suku Pteropodidae. Spesies ini menyebar terbatas (endemik) di Kepulauan Maluku. Data tentang binatang ini masih kurang diketahui.

The gray flying fox (Pteropus griseus) is a species of flying fox in the family Pteropodidae. It is found in Indonesia, but not in the Philippines, despite occasional reference to such. Very little is known about this species. It probably roosts individually or in small groups.
Canut's horseshoe bat (Rhinolophus canuti) is a species of bat in the family Rhinolophidae. It is endemic to Indonesia.
