species.summary: Amphidromus contrarius is a species of air-breathing land snail, a terrestrial pulmonate gastropod mollusk in the family Camaenidae.

Anepsion depressum adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Araneidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Anepsion dan ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1877 oleh Thorell.

Anepsion maritatum adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Araneidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Anepsion dan ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1877 oleh O P-Cambridge.
Anoplodesmus saussurii, is a species of millipedes in the family Paradoxosomatidae. It was once thought endemic to Sri Lanka, but later found from Fiji and Mauritius....
Anthene licates or White Ciliate Blue is a butterfly in the family Lycaenidae. It is found in South-east Asia.
Aoa is a monotypic genus of butterflies in the family Pieridae. The genus and its sole species, Aoa affinis, are endemic to Sulawesi.
Appias aegis, the forest white, is a butterfly in the family Pieridae. It is found in south-east Asia.

Ardeadoris cruenta is a species of very colourful sea slug, a dorid nudibranch, a marine gastropod mollusc in the family Chromodorididae. Its name is derived from the feminine form of the Latin word cruentus, which means "stained with blood" and is a reference to the red spots on its upper dorsum.
Ardeadoris egretta is a species of sea slug, a dorid nudibranch, a shell-less marine gastropod mollusc in the family Chromodorididae. It is the type species of the genus Ardeadoris.
Arestorides argus, common name : the eyed cowrie, is a species of sea snail, a cowry, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Cypraeidae, the cowries.

Argiope halmaherensis adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Araneidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Argiope dan ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1907 oleh Strand.
Arhopala acetes is a butterfly endemic to Sulawesi described by William Chapman Hewitson in 1862.
Asota javana is a moth of the Noctuidae family. It is found in Sundaland, the Philippines, Sulawesi and on Sula Island.
Attacus erebus is a moth of family Saturniidae. It is native to Sulawesi (Indonesia). This variety is bred locally and shipped worldwide to butterfly farms.

Chikunia bilde is a species of comb-footed spider in the family Theridiidae. It is found in Malaysia, Singapore, and Indonesia. The Chikunia bilde was first discovered in 2019 by researchers and is described as being unusually tolerant of human activity.
Chorodna strixaria is a moth of the Geometridae family. It is found in India, Vietnam, Sulawesi, the Philippines, the Moluccas, New Guinea, Australia and Sri Lanka.

Cocytia durvillii is a species of moth of the Erebidae family. It is an uncommon day-flying moth in lowland areas of the Moluccas, Aru, and New Guinea. The species has clear wings bordered with black, with an orange patch at the base of each forewing and long antennae, thicker at the outer end.

Colobocentrotus atratus, the helmet urchin or shingle urchin, is a species of sea urchin in the family Echinometridae. In Hawaii it is known as "kaupali" which translates as "cliff-clinging". It is found on wave-swept intertidal shores in the Indo-West Pacific, particularly on the shores of Hawaii.
Cyme xantherythra is a moth of the subfamily Arctiinae first described by George Hampson in 1900. It is found in New Guinea.

Dysphania militaris is a species of moth of the Geometridae family that is found from in the tropical regions of South and Southeast Asian countries such as China, Assam, Myanmar, Andaman Islands, Sumatra and Java.
Elymnias dara is a butterfly in the family Nymphalidae. It was described by William Burgess Pryer and William Lucas Distant in 1887. It is found in the Indomalayan realm.
Erronea errones, the wandering cowry or erroneous cowry, is a species of sea snail, a cowry, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Cypraeidae, the cowries.
The banner, (Eublemma anachoresis), is a species of moth of the Erebidae family. It is found in the Indomalaya ecozone, Australia and the southern part of Africa.

Fragum unedo is a species of cockle, a marine bivalve mollusc in the family Cardiidae, commonly known as the Pacific strawberry cockle. It is found in tropical seas in the Indo-Pacific region and the empty shells are prized for use in decorative crafts.
Gandaca harina, the tree yellow, is a butterfly in the family Pieridae. It is found in India, Thailand, Cambodia, Myanmar, Malaysia, Singapore, Philippines, and Indonesia.

Hemithyrsocera palliata is a species of cockroach endemic to the South Asia. It has a shining dark brown color and is about 12 mm (1⁄2 in) long. Its pronotum is sub-elliptical and is black with a golden yellow margin.
Jamides coritus is a butterfly in the family Lycaenidae. It was described by Félix Édouard Guérin-Méneville in 1831. It is found in New Guinea.
Lambis scorpius, common name the scorpion conch or scorpion spider conch, is a species of large sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Strombidae, the true conchs....

Liosina paradoxa adalah spesies spons yang tergolong dalam kelas Demospongiae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Liosina dan famili Dictyonellidae. Nama ilmiah spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1899 oleh Thiele.
Lymantria lunata (luna gypsy moth) is a species of moth of the family Erebidae. It is found in Southeast Asia, from India to the northeast coast of Australia.
Marumba dyras, the dull swirled hawkmoth, is a species of hawk moth described by Edmund Murton Walker in 1856. It is found in South-east and South Asia.

species.summary: Trichomyrmex destructor is a species of ant in the subfamily Myrmicinae. Its common names include destructive trailing ant or Singapore ant. It is a pest species in urban areas, known for causing costly damage to structures, vehicles, and electronic devices with its chewing activity.
Mormolyce phyllodes, commonly known as the violin Beetle, is a species of ground beetles in the subfamily Lebiinae.
Mycalesis orseis, atau kupu-kupu purple bushbrown, adalah kupu-kupu dari famili Nymphalidae. Kupu-kupu ini ditemukan di Asia Tenggara.

Myrmarachne melanocephala adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Salticidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Myrmarachne dan ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1839 oleh MacLeay.

Neoscona theisi adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Araneidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1842 oleh Walckenaer.
Oxymeris maculata, common name the Crenulate Auger, is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Terebridae, the auger snails.
Oxyopes javanus is a species of lynx spider in the family Oxyopidae. It was first described by Tamerlan Thorell in 1887 and is widely distributed across South and Southeast Asia.
Phycosoma hana is a species of spider in the family Theridiidae. It was described from China, where it is known from Hainan Island.
Pingasa ruginaria is a species of moth of the family Geometridae. It is found in northern India, south-east Asia, the Ryukyu Islands and Sundaland.
Polistes stigma is a species of paper wasp from Southeast Asia.
Pontoscolex corethrurus is an earthworm in the genus Pontoscolex. It has a circumtropical distribution, although it originates in the Neotropics, probably in the Guiana Plateau.
Rapala dioetas is a butterfly in the family Lycaenidae. It was described by William Chapman Hewitson in 1863. It is endemic to Sulawesi (Sulawesi, Sanghihe, Talaud, Banggai and Salayar).
Rapala varuna, the indigo flash, is a species of lycaenid or blue butterfly found in the Indomalayan realm and the Australasian realm.

species.name: Kipasan taliabu
species.summary: The Taliabu fantail (Rhipidura sulaensis) is a species of bird in the family Rhipiduridae. It is endemic to Taliabu in Indonesia. Its natural habitats are subtropical or tropical moist lowland forests and subtropical or tropical moist montane forests. It was considered conspecific with the rusty-bellied fantail.
Ropalidia sumatrae, the Sumatran paper wasp, is a species of paper wasp in the subfamily Polistinae. It has been recorded in Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, and Vietnam.

Scytodes fusca, the brown spitting spider, is a species of spitting spider in the family Scytodidae. It is found in Central and Southern America, has been introduced into Europe, tropical Africa, Seychelles, Myanmar, China, Japan, and Hawaii.
Taenaris catops, the silky owl, is a butterfly of the family Nymphalidae. It is found in New Guinea and surrounding islands.
Taenaris dimona is a butterfly in the family Nymphalidae. It was first described by William Chapman Hewitson in 1862. It is found in the Australasian realm.
Tagiades trebellius is a butterfly in the family Hesperiidae (subfamily Pyrginae).
The two-striped jumper, or Telamonia dimidiata, is a jumping spider found in various Asian tropical rain forests, in foliage in wooded environments.
Telicota colon, commonly known as the pale palm dart or pale-orange darter, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae.
Toxoproctis cosmia is a moth of the family Erebidae. It is found in Sundaland.
Trapania vitta is a species of sea slug, a dorid nudibranch, a marine gastropod mollusc in the family Goniodorididae.
Trischalis stomata is a moth in the family Erebidae. It was described by Holloway in 2001. It is found on Borneo, Bali and in Singapore.
Turbo petholatus, common name the tapestry turban, is a species of sea snail, marine gastropod mollusk in the family Turbinidae.
The umbrella slug (Umbraculum umbraculum) is a species of large sea snail or limpet, a marine gastropod mollusc in the family Umbraculidae.
Urapteroides astheniata is a moth of the Uraniidae family. It is found in south-east Asia, from India, Sri Lanka to Fiji, including New Guinea and the tropical north of Australia.
Urocaridella antonbruunii is a species of shrimp found in the Comoros. It was first named by A. J. Bruce in 1967.
Xyleutes strix is a moth of the Cossidae family. It is found in India, south-eastern Asia, Sundaland, the Philippines, Sulawesi, the Moluccas and New Guinea.
Agape chloropyga is a species of moth in the family Erebidae. The species is found from Malaysia to eastern Australia, including Borneo and Papua New Guinea.

Aiolopus thalassinus is a species of grasshopper belonging to the family Acrididae, subfamily Oedipodinae. It is present in most countries of Europe, in the Afrotropic ecozone to Asia and the Pacific islands.
Aliculastrum cylindricum, (common names: cylindrical atys, cylindrical true bubble, silkworm shell), is a species of gastropods belonging to the family Haminoeidae.
The tiger pistol shrimp (Alpheus bellulus) belongs to the family of snapping shrimp.
Ambulyx dohertyi is a species of moth of the family Sphingidae first described by Walter Rothschild in 1894.
Ambulyx phalaris is a species of moth of the family Sphingidae. It is known from Papua New Guinea.
Amnosia decora, the Ninja, is a butterfly of the family Nymphalidae (Pseudergolinae). It is found in the Indomalayan realm. It is the sole member of the monotypic genus Amnosia.
Antheraea larissa is a silkworm moth of the family Saturniidae found in Sundaland. The species was first described by Westwood in 1847. The larva feed on the endangered tree Shorea glauca.

Apis nigrocincta is a species of honey bee that inhabits the Philippine island of Mindanao as well as the Indonesian islands of Sangihe and the Celebes or Sulawesi. The species is known to have queens with high mating frequencies, the most of any species of the tribe Apini.
Aplysia reticulata is a species of gastropod mollusc in the genus Aplysia, family Aplysiidae....

Atys semistriatus, comon name the semistriated atys, is a species of small tropical sea snail, a bubble snail, a marine opisthobranch gastropod mollusk in the family Haminoeidae, the haminoea bubble snails....

species.name: Sapi
species.summary: Sapi, jawi atau lembu adalah hewan ternak anggota famili Bovidae dan subfamili Bovinae. Sapi dipelihara terutama untuk dimanfaatkan susu dan dagingnya sebagai pangan manusia. Hasil sampingannya seperti kulit, jeroan, tanduk, dan kotorannya juga dimanfaatkan untuk berbagai keperluan manusia.
Pycnophallium elna, the elbowed Pierrot, is a small butterfly found in India and Southeast Asia that belongs to the lycaenids or blues family.

Callidrepana saucia is a moth in the family Drepanidae first described by Felder in 1861. It is found on Peninsular Malaysia, in New Guinea (including the Bismarck Islands) and Indonesia (Moluccas, Sulawesi, Borneo, Sumatra).

Cassiopea andromeda (Upside-down jellyfish) is a type of jellyfish that usually lives in intertidal sand or mud flats, shallow lagoons, and around mangroves. This jellyfish, many times mistaken for a sea anemone, usually has its mouth upward on the bottom.
Chiasmia emersaria is a moth of the Geometridae family. It is found in India, Nepal, northern Thailand, China, Sri Lanka, Japan and the Ryukyu Islands.
Chiasmia nora is a moth of the family Geometridae. It is found in northern India, Sri Lanka, south-eastern Asia and probably throughout Sundaland.

Comostola pyrrhogona is a moth of the family Geometridae described by Francis Walker in 1866. It is found in the Indo-Australian tropics from India, Sri Lanka to Taiwan, and east to Vanuatu, New Caledonia, northern Australia and Norfolk Island.

Coscinocera hercules (Hercules moth) is a moth of the family Saturniidae, endemic to New Guinea and northern Australia. It has a wingspan of 27 centimetres (11 in), making it the largest moth found in Australia, and its wings have the largest documented surface area (300 square centimeters) of any living insect.
Daphnis dohertyi is a moth of the family Sphingidae. It is found from Indonesia, New Guinea, the Philippines the Solomon Islands and Torres Strait.

Debeckius is a genus of scarab beetles. It is monotypic, being represented by the single species, Debeckius beccarii. It is native to New Guinea. It was previously assigned to the genus Beckius, but that name was preoccupied by a fossil whitefish.
Delias momea is a butterfly in the family Pieridae. It was described by Jean Baptiste Boisduval in 1836 . It is endemic to Sumatra and Java in the Indomalayan realm.

species.name: Senangin
species.summary: Senangin (Eleutheronema tetradactylum) adalah sejenis ikan laut yang tergolong ke dalam suku Polynemidae. Ikan yang bernilai komersial penting ini menyebar terutama di perairan paparan benua Asia, mulai dari Teluk Persia ke timur hingga Australia dan Jepang selatan.
Eupholus schoenherri is a species of beetle belonging to the family Curculionidae. Eupholus petitii is sometimes included here as a subspecies.
Eurythoe complanata is a species of polychaetes belonging to the family Amphinomidae. It inhabits coral reefs, such as Heliopora reefs, in the Marshall Islands.

images.credit: Programa Marino del Golfo de California

species.summary: Gasteracantha frontata adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Araneidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1864 oleh Blackwall.

Gesonia obeditalis is a species of moth of the Noctuidae family. It is found from eastern Africa, the Seychelles, the Maldives and the Oriental tropics of India, Sri Lanka east to the Philippines, the Sula Islands and Australia. The adult moth has brown wings with a scalloped dark brown band near the margin.
Hierodula dyaka is a species of praying mantis in the family Mantidae.
Hypselodoris variobranchia is a species of sea slug or dorid nudibranch, a marine gastropod mollusc in the family Chromodorididae.

Ischiodon scutellaris, commonly known as the common hover fly or yellow-shouldered hover fly, is a species of hover fly found in India, Turkey to Japan and Australia, as well as all the Pacific islands except for Hawaii.

The redback spider (Latrodectus hasseltii) is a species of highly venomous spider believed to originate in the South Australian or adjacent Western Australian deserts, but now found throughout Australia, Southeast Asia and New Zealand, with colonies elsewhere outside Australia.

Lemyra maculifascia is a moth of the family Erebidae. It was described by Francis Walker in 1855. It is found in China (Shandong, Yunnan), Indonesia (Sumatra, Nias, Java, Bali, Borneo, Sulawesi, the Moluccas, Ambon Island, Buru, Lombok, Dammer, Aru), Timor, the Philippines, New Guinea and Australia (Western Australia a…
Leporicypraea mappa (previously known as Cypraea mappa), common name the map cowry, is a species of large sea snail, a cowry, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Cypraeidae, the cowries.
Lexias canescens, the yellow archduke, is a species of butterfly belonging to the family Nymphalidae. It was first described by Arthur Gardiner Butler in 1869.
Ligyra tantalus adalah spesies lalat yang berasal dari genus Ligyra dan famili Bombyliidae. Lalat ini juga merupakan bagian dari ordo Diptera, kelas Insecta, filum Arthropoda, dan kingdom Animalia.

Linckia guildingi, juga disebut bintang komet umum, bintang laut Guilding atau Linckia hijau, adalah sebuah spesies bintang laut yang dilaporkan dari perairan dangkal kawasan tropis Samudra Pasifik, Samudra Hindia, Samudra Atlantik dan Laut Karibia.
Marmaronchis vaigiensis is a species of air-breathing sea slug, a shell-less marine pulmonate gastropod mollusc in the family Onchidiidae.
Nerita undata is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Neritidae.
Nicrophorus distinctus is a burying beetle described by A.H. Grouvelle in 1885.
Ourapteryx claretta is a moth of the Geometridae family. It is found in Sundaland.
Palmadusta contaminata is a species of sea snail, a cowry, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Cypraeidae, the cowries.
Pellasimnia annabelae is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Ovulidae, the ovulids, cowry allies or false cowries.

Phaeacius fimbriatus adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Salticidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Phaeacius dan ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1900 oleh Simon.
Plocamopherus ceylonicus is a species of sea slug, a nudibranch, a shell-less marine gastropod mollusk in the family Polyceridae.
Pollia undosa, common name : the waved goblet, is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Pisaniidae, the true whelks.

Poltys illepidus is a species of spider in the family Araneidae. It was first described by C. L. Koch in 1843. The species is distributed across northern Australia, Papua New Guinea, and Southeast Asia, extending north to Thailand and Japan.
Pompelon is a monotypic moth genus in the family Zygaenidae erected by Francis Walker in 1854. Its only species, Pompelon marginata, was first described by Félix Édouard Guérin-Méneville in 1843.

species.name: Rajungan Bintang
species.summary: The three-spot swimming crab (Portunus sanguinolentus), also known as the blood-spotted swimming crab or red-spotted swimming crab, is a large crab found throughout estuaries of the Indian and West Pacific Oceanic countries.
Pseudoceros susanae is a marine flatworm species that belongs to the Pseudocerotidae family.
Pyrops sultana is a species of lanternfly found on the island of Borneo.
Rhysida longipes, sometimes known as Minor blue leg, is a species of centipedes in the family Scolopendridae. Three subspecies recognized. It is sometimes used as a pet in some countries.

Siliquofera is a genus of bush cricket in the subfamily Phyllophorinae that includes only one species, Siliquofera grandis, which is fairly common and widespread in rainforest canopies of New Guinea and nearby smaller islands, and seemingly rare (possibly overlooked) in Australia where only found in the remote Iron Ran…

Talanga sabacusalis is a moth in the family Crambidae. It was described by Francis Walker in 1859. It is found on Borneo, Java, Sumatra, Sulawesi and in Papua New Guinea, Cambodia, the Philippines, as well as Australia, where it has been recorded from Queensland.
Talparia talpa, common name the mole cowry or chocolate banded cowry, is a species of sea snail, a cowry, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Cypraeidae, the cowries.
Therates labiatus adalah spesies kumbang dalam familia Carabidae. Spesies ini ditemukan di Indonesia, Papua Nugini, dan Kepulauan Solomon.
Trapania gibbera is a species of sea slug, a dorid nudibranch, a marine gastropod mollusc in the family Goniodorididae.
Tubuca dussumieri, is a species of fiddler crab that is found in the western and south pacific including New Caledonia, Indonesia, Malaysia, Taiwan, Japan, north eastern Australia

Tumidodromia dormia, the sleepy sponge crab or common sponge crab, is the largest species of sponge crab and the only species in the genus Tumidodromia. It grows to a carapace width of 20 cm (8 in) and lives in shallow waters across the Indo-Pacific region.
Abroscelis longipes is a species of tiger beetle in the genus Abroscelis.

Acosmeryx shervillii, the dull forest hawkmoth, is a moth of the family Sphingidae. It is found from the Indian subregion of India, Sri Lanka, to Sundaland, the Philippines and Sulawesi. Acosmeryx pseudonaga is sometimes treated as a valid species.

Acusilas malaccensis adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Araneidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Acusilas dan ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1983 oleh Murphy Murphy.
Aethaloessa calidalis is a moth of the Crambidae family. It is found throughout the Seychelles, South and South-East Asia, Australia and on many Pacific islands.

Agrioglypta eurytusalis is a moth in the Crambidae family. It is found in southern India, Sri Lanka, Borneo, Cambodia, Thailand, Taiwan, Japan and Australia, where it has been recorded from northern Queensland.
Ahaetulla rufusoculara, the red-eyed vine snake, is a species of snake in the family Colubridae. It is endemic to Vietnam where it is known from the Sóc Trăng province.

Amphimedon queenslandica adalah spesies spons yang tergolong dalam kelas Demospongiae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Amphimedon dan famili Niphatidae. Nama ilmiah spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 2006 oleh Hooper van Soest.

Botrylloides leachii is a colonial tunicate of the genus Botrylloides. Its unique methods of propagation and regeneration make it an ideal model organism for use in biological study of development, immunology, stem cells, and regeneration.
Callidula fasciata is a moth in the family Callidulidae. It is found on Ternate.
Calliteara horsfieldii, or Horsfield's tussock moth, is a moth of the family Erebidae. The species was first described by Saunders in 1851.
Canarium labiatum, common name the Samar Conch, is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Strombidae, the true conchs.

Cechenena helops is a moth of the Sphingidae family. It is found in Malaysia (Peninsular, Sarawak, Sabah), Indonesia (Sumatra, Java, Kalimantan, Seram, Papua New Guinea), the Philippines (Palawan, Balabac), Nepal, north-eastern India, Thailand, south-western China and Vietnam.

Charon grayi, the giant whip-spider, is a species of whip spider found in Malaysia, Singapore, Philippines, Indonesia, Papua New Guinea, the Solomon Islands and Palau. This whip-spider usually lives in caves.
Choreutis basalis is a species of moth of the family Choreutidae. It is found in eastern Queensland, from Cape York to Yeppoon. It is also present in New Guinea and Indonesia.
Cribrarula cribraria, the 'Sieve/Tan and White Cowry', is a species of sea snail, a cowry, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Cypraeidae, the cowries.

The cat flea (scientific name Ctenocephalides felis) is an extremely common parasitic insect whose principal host is the domestic cat, although a high proportion of the fleas found on dogs also belong to this species (this despite the widespread existence of a separate and well-established "dog" flea, Ctenocephalides c…

images.credit: licensed media from BioImages DwCA without owner

species.summary: Cyclommatus is a genus of the Lucanidae family, also known as the stag beetle. The majority of the species from the genus Cyclommatus are located in Southeast Asia, though some species can be found in China and Taiwan as well.

Cylas formicarius (Hama boleng)adalah hama yang diperkirakan berasal dari Afrika atau India. Hama ini menyerang ubi jalar dan dapat menghilangkan hasil panen hingga 100%. Larva serangga ini menyerang umbi dan membuat umbi menjadi berlubang dan terasa pahit.

Cyrtarachne nagasakiensis adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Araneidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1918 oleh Strand.
Delias caroli is a butterfly in the family Pieridae. It was described by George Hamilton Kenrick in 1909. It is found in New Guinea.

Ercheia dubia is a species of moth of the family Erebidae first described by Arthur Gardiner Butler in 1874. It is found in Asia (including Korea and Japan) and in Australia (Northern Territory and Queensland) and New Guinea

The Dot-underwing moth, (Eudocima materna), known as is a moth of the family Erebidae found in widespread parts of the world, mainly in tropical Asia extending to New Guinea and Australia as well as in Africa. Reports from the United States, Canada and the French Antilles are now considered to be Eudocima apta.
Gibberulus gibberulus, common name the humpbacked conch, is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Strombidae, the true conchs.
Gnathothlibus heliodes is a moth of the family Sphingidae. It is known from Papua New Guinea and some adjacent islands.
Goniobranchus albopunctatus is a species of colourful sea slug, a dorid nudibranch, a marine gastropod mollusc in the family Chromodorididae.

Graphium aristeus, the chain swordtail, is a butterfly in the family Papilionidae (swallowtails). It is found in the Indomalaya ecozone. The Indian subspecies G. a. anticrates is protected by law in India. It is found in Sikkim, Bhutan, Meghalaya, West Bengal and Assam.
Graptostethus servus is a species of seed bug in the family Lygaeidae. It is found in Europe, Asia, Australia, and in the Pacific region. Larvae are grey and are prey items for chickens.
Harmonia octomaculata (the large spotted ladybird) is a species of ladybird (the family Coccinellidae). Found in India, Pakistan, Nepal, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, Micronesia, and Australia.
Harpa harpa, common name the true harp or the noble harp, is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Harpidae, the harp snails.

The solitary ascidian Herdmania momus is one of the most commonly encountered species of ascidians. While commonly referred to simply as sea squirts, this name is ambiguous, as it can refer to any member of the sub-phylum Tunicata.
Hulodes caranea is a species of moth of the Erebidae family. It is found from India, Sri Lanka, Myanmar, Java, Hong Kong to Queensland and New Guinea, it is also found on the Marianas and Carolines.
Illeis is a genus of ladybird beetles in the family Coccinellidae. There are about five described species in Illeis, found in south and east Asia and in Oceania.
Isis hippuris is a species of bamboo coral found in the Western Pacific Ocean. It produces hippuristanol, a molecule with apparent anti-cancer functions.

Lymantria subrosea is a moth of the family Erebidae first described by Francis Walker in 1855. It is found from Sri Lanka to China and Sundaland, the Philippines, Sulawesi, Seram, the Lesser Sundas to Timor. The Sumatran population is categorized under the subspecies, Lymantria subrosea singapura.
Lyssa menoetius is a moth of the family Uraniidae. The species was first described by German entomologist Hopffer in 1856.

Meandrusa payeni, the yellow gorgon, is a species of swallowtail found in parts of South Asia and Southeast Asia. It belongs to the hooked swallowtails genus, Meandrusa, of the family Papilionidae. It is also called the outlet sword or the sickle.
Melibe colemani, also known as the Coleman's melibe, ghost nudi, or ghost melibe, is a species of nudibranch in the family Tethydidae.
Mexichromis aurora is a species of sea slug or dorid nudibranch, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Chromodorididae.
Mexichromis pusilla is a species of sea slug or dorid nudibranch, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Chromodorididae.
Micropholcus fauroti is a cellar spider species with Pantropical distribution. It has been introduced in Belgium and Germany.
Nardoa is a genus of sea stars in the family Ophidiasteridae.
Notodoris serenae is a species of sea slug. It is a dorid nudibranch, a shell-less marine gastropod mollusc in the family Aegiridae.
Ocypode cordimanus is a species of crab in the family Ocypodidae, sometimes called the smooth-handed ghost crab. It is widely distributed in the Indian Ocean and Pacific Ocean.
Papilio paris, the Paris peacock, is a species of swallowtail butterfly found in the Indian subcontinent and Southeast Asia.
Papilio pericles is a butterfly of the family Papilionidae. It is found from the Philippines and Malaysia to Indonesia (Sumatra, Java, Borneo and Sulawesi).
Paraleptuca crassipes or the thick-legged fiddler crab is a species of fiddler crab that lives in intertidal habitats distributed across the western Pacific Ocean.
Pardosa sumatrana is a species of wolf spider in the family Lycosidae. It was first described by Tamerlan Thorell in 1890 from specimens collected in Sumatra.

Parnara bada, the African straight swift, grey swift or Ceylon swift, is a butterfly of the Hesperiidae family. It is found in south-east Asia, from India through China to Indonesia, as well as the north-east coast of Australia.
Penicillifera apicalis is a moth of the Bombycidae family. It is found from the north-eastern parts of the Himalaya to Sundaland and the Philippines.
Penthicodes atomaria is a species of lantern flies belonging to the family Fulgoridae.
Phyllodesmium colemani is a species of sea slug, an aeolid nudibranch, a marine gastropod mollusc in the family Facelinidae.
Prosopocoilus astacoides is a beetle of the Family Lucanidae.
Prothoe franck, the blue begum, is a butterfly species found in Assam in north-eastern India and throughout a large part of South-East Asia.

Pycnoclavella diminuta, common names white-spotted sea squirt, white-spot ascidian, and white-spotted ascidian is a species of tunicate (sea squirt), in the genus Pycnoclavella. Like all ascidians, these sessile animals are filter feeders.

Pystira ephippigera adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Salticidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Pystira dan ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1885 oleh Simon.

Scolopendra dehaani, the giant Vietnamese centipede, is a large scolopendrid centipede found across Mainland Southeast Asia. It is also found in India, Japan, Hong Kong, and the Andaman and Nicobar Islands.

Scylla serrata atau yang juga dikenal sebagai kepiting-bakau besar (giant mangrove crab, giant mud crab) adalah sejenis kepiting bakau yang menyebar luas mulai dari pantai-pantai Asia Timur, Tenggara, Selatan, hingga ke Laut Merah. Spesies ini tidak didapati di perairan Dangkalan Sunda....
Somena similis is a moth in the family Erebidae. It was described by Moore in 1860. It is found from India to Sundaland.
Strigoptera bimaculata is the type species in its genus of jewel beetles: in the tribe Polycestini. Distribution records are from south-East Asia.
Sympis rufibasis is a moth of the Noctuidae family. It is found from the Indo-Australian tropics of India, Sri Lanka, Borneo east to New Guinea, the Solomons and Queensland.
Tacua speciosa is a very large Southeast Asian species of cicada. It is the only member of its genus.
Terebellum terebellum, common name the Terebellum conch, is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Seraphsidae, the true conchs.
Thermograpta is a genus of moths in the family Erebidae. It contains the single species Thermograpta rufizonata, which is found in New Guinea.
Thuridilla carlsoni is a species of sacoglossan sea slug, a shell-less marine opisthobranch gastropod mollusk in the family Plakobranchidae.

Trabala vishnou, the rose-myrtle lappet moth, is a moth of the Lasiocampidae family. It is found in south-east Asia, including India, Thailand, Sri Lanka, Myanmar, Java, China, Japan, Hong Kong, and Indonesia. Four subspecies are recognized.
Trypanophora semihyalina is a species of moth in the Zygaenidae family. It is found in south-east Asia, including India and China.

Allora doleschallii (peacock awl) is a butterfly of the family Hesperiidae. It is found from Indonesia to the Solomon Islands, while subspecies Allora doleschallii doleschallii is found on the north-east coast of Australia.The name honours Carl Ludwig Doleschall.
Aloa laetata (red costate tiger moth) is a moth of family Erebidae. It is found in India, Japan, southern and western China, Taiwan, Java, Sumatra, Sri Lanka, Burma and the Philippines.
Ambulyx pryeri is a moth of the family Sphingidae. It is found in Sundaland.
Amphipholis squamata, common names brooding snake star and dwarf brittle star, is a species of brittle star in the family Amphiuridae.
Angaria delphinus, common name the common delphinula, is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusc of the family Angariidae.
Appias ada, the rare albatross, is a butterfly of the family Pieridae. It is found on the Moluccas, New Guinea, Indonesia, Australia and the Solomon Islands.

species.name: Pijantung Kalimantan
species.summary: Pijantung kalimantan (Arachnothera everetti) adalah spesies burung dalam keluarga Nectariniidae. Nama ilmiahnya untuk mengenang administrator kolonial dan kolektor zoologi dari Inggris, Alfred Hart Everett.

Argiope aetherea adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Araneidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Argiope dan ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1842 oleh Walckenaer.
Asota paphos is a moth of the family Erebidae. It is found from the north-eastern Himalaya to Sundaland.
Atrophaneura dixoni is a species of butterfly from the family Papilionidae that is found in northern and central Sulawesi, Indonesia.
Callidula jucunda is a moth of the family Callidulidae. It is endemic to Sundaland, a biogeographical region of Southeastern Asia.
Canarium urceus is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Strombidae, the true conchs.
Cecidochares connexa adalah spesies lalat yang tergolong famili Tephritidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari ordo Diptera, kelas Insecta, filum Arthropoda, dan kingdom Animalia.
Chalcidica pallescens is a moth in the family Cossidae. It was described by Roepke in 1955. It is found in New Guinea and on the Solomon Islands.

species.name: Rajungan Karang
species.summary: Rajungan karang (Charybdis feriata) adalah sejenis rajungan yang cukup banyak dikonsumsi, anggota suku Portunidae. Rajungan ini terutama menyebar di perairan tropis dan ugahari Indo-Pasifik Barat hingga Jepang dan Australia, serta Atlantik.

The northern snake-necked turtle (Chelodina oblonga) is a species of turtle in the Chelidae family or Austro-South American Side-necked Turtles. The species was described in 1841 from material collected during an expedition across northern Australia.
The mangrove murex (Chicoreus capucinus) is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Muricidae, the murex snails or rock snails.

species.name: Camar Kepala-Hitam
species.summary: The black-headed gull (Chroicocephalus ridibundus) is a small gull that breeds in much of Europe and Asia, and also in coastal eastern Canada. Most of the population is migratory and winters further south, but some birds reside in the milder westernmost areas of Europe.
Chromodoris dianae is a species of sea slug, a dorid nudibranch, a shell-less marine gastropod mollusc in the family Chromodorididae.
Comostola laesaria is a moth of the family Geometridae. It is found in Sri Lanka, India, Indochina, southern China, Taiwan, Sundaland, northern Australia and the Bismarck Archipelago.

The north Moluccan cicadabird (Edolisoma grayi) is a passerine bird in the family Campephagidae that is found on Halmahera, the Bacan Islands, the Tukangbesi Islands and the island of Morotai in the northern Moluccas Islands of Indonesia.

Corinnomma severum is a species of spider in the family Corinnidae. It has a wide distribution across Asia, ranging from India to China, and extending through the Philippines and parts of Indonesia including Sumatra and Sulawesi.

Culex quinquefasciatus Say, 1823 (originally named Culex fatigans), commonly known as the southern house mosquito, is a medium-sized mosquito found in tropical and subtropical regions of the world. It is the vector of Wuchereria bancrofti, avian malaria, and arboviruses including St.
Cyphogastra semipurpurea is a beetle of the Buprestidae family. It is Endemic to Timor
Dardanus gemmatus, the jeweled anemone hermit crab, is a species of hermit crab native to tropical reefs surrounding the Indo-Pacific, typically at depths of 2–100 metres (10–330 ft).
Delias oraia is a butterfly in the family Pieridae. It was described by William Doherty in 1891. It is found in the Australasian realm.
Delias toxopei is a butterfly in the family Pieridae. It was described by Roepke in 1955. It is found in New Guinea.

Duomitus is a monotypic moth genus in the family Cossidae described by Arthur Gardiner Butler in 1880. Its only species, Duomitus ceramicus, described by Francis Walker in 1865, is found in China (Yunnan) and from southern India and Malaysia to Sumatra, Ceram and New Guinea.

Erebus macrops is a species of moth of the family Erebidae. It is found in the subtropical regions of Africa and Asia. The wingspan is about 12 cm, making it exceptionally large for an Erebidae species. The larvae feed on Acacia and Entada species.
Annulorhina mandapamensis is a species of sea slug or nudibranch, a marine gastropod mollusc in the family Eubranchidae.
Euploea crameri, the spotted black crow, is a butterfly found in Asia that belongs to the crows and tigers, that is, the Danaid group of the brush-footed butterflies family.

Gasteracantha irradiata adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Araneidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1842 oleh Walckenaer.
Gastrimargus marmoratus is a species of band-winged grasshopper in the family Acrididae. It is found in southern Africa, Indomalaya, and eastern Asia.

Gea bituberculata adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Araneidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1881 oleh Thorell.

Gelliodes fibulata adalah spesies spons yang tergolong dalam kelas Demospongiae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Gelliodes dan famili Niphatidae. Nama ilmiah spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1881 oleh Carter.
Glenea venus is a species of beetle in the family Cerambycidae. It was described by James Thomson in 1865. It is known from Papua New Guinea, Australia and Indonesia.

Gnathothlibus eras is a moth of the family Sphingidae. It is known from the eastern Sunda Islands (from Java eastward), Sulawesi, the Moluccas, the Philippines, New Guinea, the Solomon Islands, Micronesia and eastern Australia.

Hasora discolor, the green awl, is a butterfly of the family Hesperiidae. It is found as several subspecies in Australia (where it is found along the south-eastern coast of New South Wales and the northern Gulf and north-eastern coast of Queensland), the Aru Islands, Irian Jaya, the Kei Islands, Maluku and Papua New Gu…
Hasora taminatus, the white banded awl, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae, which is found in Asia.
Heteropoda davidbowie is a species of huntsman spider of the Heteropoda genus. It was described from the Cameron Highlands District in peninsular Malaysia and named in honor of singer David Bowie.
Kabeiro rubroreticulata is a species of sea slug, a dendronotid nudibranch, a marine gastropod mollusc in the family Dotidae.

Leucetta microraphis adalah spesies spons yang tergolong dalam kelas Calcarea. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari filum Porifera, subregnum Parazoa, dan regnum Animalia. Nama ilmiah spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1872 oleh Haeckel.
Lobiger viridis is a species of small sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Oxynoidae.

species.name: eteman
species.summary: Mene maculata, the Moonfish, is the only extant member of the genus Mene and of the family Menidae. The body is highly compressed laterally and very deep vertically. The ventral profile is steep, with a sharp ventral edge. The caudal (tail) fin is deeply forked. The mouth is small and protrusible.
Mithrodia clavigera is a species of tropical starfish in the family Mithrodiidae.
Myopopone castanea is a species of ant in the genus Myopopone. It was described by Smith in 1860.

Neoscona punctigera adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Araneidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1857 oleh Doleschall.

Oeonistis altica is a member of family Erebidae. It is found in south-east Asia, including China, Hong Kong, Laos, Vietnam, Indonesia, northern India, the Philippines, Taiwan as well as in Australia in Queensland.

Orgyia postica, the cocoa tussock moth or hevea tussock moth, is a species of moth of the Lymantriinae subfamily of family Erebidae found from the Oriental tropics of India, Sri Lanka, Myanmar, Borneo, Java, New Guinea and Taiwan. It was described by Francis Walker in 1855.
Oxynoe viridis is a species of small sea snail or sea slug, a bubble snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Oxynoidae.
Palmadusta clandestina is a species of sea snail, a cowry, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Cypraeidae, the cowries.
Athyma selenophora, the staff sergeant, is a species of nymphalid butterfly found in tropical and subtropical Asia.

species.summary: The Malabar trevally (Carangoides malabaricus), also known as the Malabar jack, Malabar kingfish or nakedshield kingfish, is a species of large inshore marine fish of the jack family, Carangidae.

species.name: Rajungan Biasa
species.summary: Rajungan biasa, rajungan bunga, atau rajungan biru (Portunus pelagicus) adalah sejenis kepiting yang hidup di laut. Jenis ini biasanya ditemukan di wilayah pantai yang dangkal, terutama di perairan Samudra Pasifik bagian barat.

Sameodes cancellalis is a species of moth of the Crambidae family. It has a wide distribution and has been recorded from India, Sri Lanka, Nepal, Burma, Thailand, Indochina, Taiwan, Japan, China, Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, New Guinea, western and southern Africa, Fiji, the Cook Islands and Australia (Queensl…
Syphonota geographica, or the geographic sea hare, is a species of sea slug or sea hare, a marine opisthobranch gastropod mollusk in the family Aplysiidae, the sea hares.
Talanga sexpunctalis is a moth of the Crambidae family. It is found in south-east Asia, including Kolkata, Hong Kong, New Guinea, Thailand and Queensland in Australia.
Terebralia sulcata is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Potamididae.
Tridentarius dentatus, common name : the Toothed Conch, is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Strombidae, the true conchs.
Neritina turrita is a species of aquatic snail, a gastropod mollusk in the family Neritidae.

Xylocopa fenestrata, or Xylocopa (Ctenoxylocopa) fenestrata, is a species of carpenter bee. It is widely distributed in Asian countries and very few African countries such as Madagascar and Seychelles. It is considered as a pest of timber and bamboo, but is also a valuable pollinator.

Xystrocera globosa adalah spesies kumbang tanduk panjang yang tergolong familia Cerambycidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Xystrocera, ordo Coleoptera, kelas Insecta, filum Arthropoda, dan kingdom Animalia.
Zeuxidia aurelius, the giant Saturn, is a species of butterfly of the Nymphalidae family. It is found in Sumatra, Peninsular Malaysia and Borneo.

Acherontia styx, the lesser death's head hawkmoth or bee robber, is a sphingid moth found in Asia, one of the three species of death's-head hawkmoth. It is very fond of honey, and bee keepers have reported finding dead moths in their hives as a result of bee stings.

Acosmeryx shervillii, the dull forest hawkmoth, is a moth of the family Sphingidae. It is found from the Indian subregion of India, Sri Lanka, to Sundaland, the Philippines and Sulawesi. Acosmeryx pseudonaga is sometimes treated as a valid species.
Adelomorpha is a genus of moths in the family Gelechiidae. It contains the species Adelomorpha ritsemae, which is found on Sulawesi, an island in Indonesia.
Gobi pembawa telur (Adrianichthys oophorus) adalah sebuah spesies ikan dari famili Adrianichthyidae. Spesies ini termasuk jenis yang endemik di Danau Poso di Sulawesi, Indonesia.

Amblypodia narada is a species of butterfly belonging to the lycaenid family described by Thomas Horsfield in 1828. It is found in Southeast Asia (Java, Borneo, Philippines, Sulawesi, southern Burma, Thailand, Peninsular Malaya and Sumatra).
Ambulyx celebensis is a species of moth in the family Sphingidae. It was described by Jordan in 1919, and is known from Indonesia.
Amphidromus porcellanus is a species of air-breathing land snail, a terrestrial pulmonate gastropod mollusc in the family Camaenidae.
Antheraea helferi is a moth of the family Saturniidae first described by Frederic Moore in 1858. It is found in the north-eastern Himalaya and Sundaland.
Atagema spongiosa is a species of sea slug or dorid nudibranch, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Discodorididae.
The bumpnose trevally (Atropus hedlandensis), also known as the bumpnose kingfish or onion kingfish, is a species of relatively small inshore marine fish classified in the jack family Carangidae.
Kecoak jerman (Blattella germanica) adalah sebuah spesies kecoak kecil, umumnya memiliki panjang sekitar 1,1 hingga 1,6 cm (0,43 hingga 0,63 in). Warna bervariasi dari cokelat hingga hampir hitam.

Burmattus albopunctatus adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Salticidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Burmattus dan ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1895 oleh Thorell.

Celaenorrhinus ficulnea, the velvet flat, is a species of butterfly in the family Hesperiidae. It is found in south-east Asia. The typical form exhibits the white central spot of the forewing above and beneath straightly cut off by the lower median branch. In some taxonomic schemes (e.g.
Cepora aspasia is a butterfly in the family Pieridae, found in Indonesia.

Charaxes bernardus, the tawny rajah, is a butterfly that belongs to the rajahs and nawabs group, that is, the Charaxinae group of the brush-footed butterflies family. This species can be found in India, China, Indomalaya, and onwards to Indonesia.

Charaxes latona, the orange emperor, is a butterfly of the rajahs and nawabs group, i.e. the Charaxinae group of the brush-footed butterflies family. It is native to the tropical rainforests of eastern Indonesia, western Melanesia and far northern Queensland, Australia, where it is limited to the Iron Range.
