Chelycypraea testudinaria, common name the tortoise cowry, is a species of sea snail, a cowry, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Cypraeidae, the cowries.
Choaspes plateni, the branded awlking, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae which is found in Asia.
Chorodna complicataria is a moth of the family Geometridae. It is found in Sundaland.
Chromodoris michaeli is a species of colorful sea slug, a dorid nudibranch, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Chromodorididae.
Clathrina repens is a species of calcareous sponge from the Western Indian Ocean and Red Sea.

images.credit: (Photo a, a1: N.J. de Voogd) van Soest, R.W.M. & de Voogd, N.J. 2018.

species.summary: Cleora alienaria is a moth of the family Geometridae first described by Francis Walker in 1860. It is found in Sri Lanka, the Indian subregion to the Andaman Islands, Thailand, Sundaland, Taiwan, and Lesser Sundas as far east as Timor and Christmas Island.

images.credit: Alan Kwok (King Lun), Ada Tai (Ah Heung) / 阿達蘭 AdAlan
Crabs' Promenade カニの散歩道

species.summary: Cormocephalus dentipes is a species of centipede in the family Scolopendridae.
Creugas gulosus is a species of true spider in the family Corinnidae. It is found in Southern America, has been introduced into Africa, Myanmar, Australia, and Pacific islands.
Cubaris murina, the little sea pillbug, is a species of woodlouse in the family Armadillidae. It is found in North America.

Curetis insularis is a species of butterfly belonging to the lycaenid family. It is found in the Indomalayan realm (Java, Peninsular Malaya, Borneo, Sumatra, Thailand). Curetis insularis was described by Horsfield in 1829.
Cyclommatus canaliculatus is a species of beetles belonging to the family Lucanidae.
Cyclosia panthona is a moth in the family Zygaenidae. It was described by Caspar Stoll in 1780. It is found in China, Hong Kong, India, Sri Lanka, and Myanmar.
Cyerce kikutarobabai is a species of sacoglossan sea slug, a shell-less marine opisthobranch gastropod mollusk in the family Caliphyllidae.
Cyrestis telamon is a butterfly of the family Nymphalidae. It is found in Indonesia (Maluku Islands).
Daldorfia horrida, the horrid elbow crab, is a species of elbow crab in the family Parthenopidae. It is native to tropical and subtropical waters of the Indo-Pacific.
Delias albertisi is a species of butterfly in the family Pieridae. It was first described by Charles Oberthür in 1880 and is found in New Guinea.
Dendrelaphis lineolatus atau ular-tali irian adalah spesies ular dalam famili Colubridae . Spesies ini ditemukan di Indonesia dan Papua Nugini .
Dindica polyphaenaria is a moth of the family Geometridae. It is found in Taiwan, the Himalaya, south-east Asia and Sundaland.
Discotettix belzebuth is a groundhopper species found in western Malesia, belonging to the subfamily Scelimeninae; it is the type species of its genus.

Dolichognatha longiceps is a species of spider in the family Tetragnathidae, found in India, Myanmar and Thailand. In 2014, it was suggested that the species be transferred back to the genus Prolochus, where it was placed by Tamerlan Thorell in 1895, but as of May 2016, this has not been accepted by secondary sources,…
Drepane punctata, commonly known as the concertina fish or banded sicklefish, is a fish native to the waters of northern Australia and New Guinea.

Dysidea frondosa adalah spesies spons yang tergolong dalam kelas Demospongiae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Dysidea dan famili Dysideidae. Nama ilmiah spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1995 oleh Berquist.
The diadema urchin or blue-black urchin (Echinothrix diadema) is a species of tropical sea urchin, member of the Diadematidae family.
Engina zonalis is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Pisaniidae.

The Bornean forktail (Enicurus borneensis) is a small, black and white bird, with a long and deeply forked tail, in the Old World flycatcher family. It is endemic to the Southeast Asian island of Borneo, where it occupies streamside habitats in montane primary forest.
Eressa confinis is a moth of the family Erebidae. It was described by Francis Walker in 1854. It is found in India (Sikkim, the Nilgiris), Bhutan, Sri Lanka, Burma, Taiwan and China.
Eristalinus megacephalus is a species of hoverfly.
Euchomenella heteroptera is a species of mantis, also known as the "giraffe mantis", in the family Deroplatyidae.

Eucidaris metularia, the ten-lined urchin, is a species of sea urchins in the family Cidaridae. It is found in shallow parts of the Indo-Pacific Ocean and is characterised by its sparse covering of banded, flat-tipped spines.
Eupterote undata is a moth of the family Eupterotidae. It is found in Pakistan, India, Sri Lanka, Burma, Sumatra, Java and the Philippines.

Euripus nyctelius, the courtesan, is an Indomalayan butterfly of the family Nymphalidae. It was first described by Henry Doubleday in 1845. The females mimic Euploea species. The larva feeds on Trema orientalis.

images.credit: Crabs' Promenade カニの散歩道

species.summary: Gnathothlibus dabrera is a moth of the family Sphingidae. It is known from Sulawesi.
Gnathothlibus erotus (white-brow hawkmoth) is a moth of the family Sphingidae. It is found from India to Borneo.
Grammodes geometrica is a moth found from the Mediterranean east to Oriental and Australasian tropics of India, Sri Lanka, Java and Australia. Adult is a fruit-piercer.
Habrona alboplagata is a moth in the family Drepanidae. It was described by George Thomas Bethune-Baker in 1908. It is found in Papua New Guinea.
Habrona papuata is a moth in the family Drepanidae. It is found in Papua and Papua New Guinea, where it has been recorded from mountainous areas.
Hasora chromus, the common banded awl, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae which is found in the Indian subcontinent, Southeast Asia and Australia.
Hemiplecta humphreysiana is a species of air-breathing land snails, terrestrial pulmonate gastropod mollusks in the family Ariophantidae.

Herpetogramma licarsisalis, the grass webworm or tropical grass webworm, is a moth of the Crambidae family. It is native to most of the old world tropics, including New Zealand, Hong Kong and Queensland. It is an introduced species in many other parts of the world, including Hawaii and the Canary Islands.
Horridipamera nietneri is a species of dirt-colored seed bug in the family Rhyparochromidae, found in Indomalaya.
Hyalobathra minialis is a moth in the Crambidae family. It was described by Warren in 1895. It is found in Australia, where it has been recorded from Queensland.
Hyarotis adrastus, the tree flitter, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae.

Hyblaea constellata is a moth in the Hyblaeidae family. It is found in India, Sri Lanka, south-east Asia, including China, Japan, Taiwan, Myanmar and Thailand. It is also found in Queensland, Australia.

Hymenia perspectalis, the spotted beet webworm moth, is a species of moth of the Crambidae family. It is found in various parts of the world, including North America, where it is found from Maine to Florida, west to Texas and north to Michigan and Ontario.
The giant honeycomb oyster (Hyotissa hyotis) is a very large saltwater oyster, a marine bivalve mollusk.

Hyposidra infixaria is a geometer moth in the Ennominae subfamily. It is found in Northwestern Himalaya, Southern China, Taiwan and Sundaland, mainly in lowland forests. There is great variation in wing color, presence or absence of the subcostal line.
Hypselodoris maridadilus is a species of colourful sea slug or dorid nudibranch, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Chromodorididae. It feeds on sponges.
Hypselodoris purpureomaculosa is a species of colourful sea slug or dorid nudibranch, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Chromodorididae.
Idea lynceus, the tree-nymph, is a species of nymphalid butterfly in the Danainae subfamily. It is found in South East Asia.
Ischyja ferrifracta is a species of moth of the family Noctuidae first described by Francis Walker in 1864.

Ischyja manlia is a species of moth of the Noctuidae family. It is found in the Indian Subregion, Sri Lanka, Burma, Thailand, China, Okinawa, Sundaland, Sulawesi, the southern Moluccas, Australia (Queensland) and Palau. Adults pierce the skin of fruit to suck the juice. It was also found recently from Korea.
Jamides malaccanus is a butterfly of the lycaenids or blues family. It is found on Peninsular Malaysia, Pulau Tioman, Pulau Aur, Sumatra, Java, Langkawi and probably in southern Thailand.

Lelemah (Lactarius lactarius) adalah jenis ikan yang saat ini merupakan satu-satunya spesies dalam famili Lactariidae. Ikan ini juga dikenal sebagai Ikan Susu; Lapa Iaai; Kapas-Kapas; Babete Lubangan; Tambi-Tambi; Budo; Ramas; Lemah Susu; Selah; Klemes; Silea; Ikan Batang; Raramas.
Poliobotys ablactalis is a moth of the Crambidae family. It occurs throughout south-east Asia, including Réunion, Australia, Hong Kong and Africa (Kenya, Senegal, South Africa).

Lasippa tiga, the Burmese lascar, is an Indomalayan butterfly of the family Nymphalidae. It was first described by Frederic Moore in 1858. The larva feeds on Cratoxylon species (shrubs or small to medium-sized trees).
Lebeda nobilis is a moth of the family Lasiocampidae. It is found in Taiwan, China, India, Nepal and Indonesia.
Lemaireia loepoides is a species of moth of the family Saturniidae first described by Arthur Gardiner Butler in 1880. It is found on Borneo, Sumatra and Peninsular Malaysia.

Walang sangit (Leptocorisa oratorius Fabricius, (Hemiptera:Alydidae); syn. Leptocorisa acuta) adalah serangga yang menjadi hama penting pada tanaman budidaya, terutama padi. Di Indonesia, serangga ini disebut: kungkang (Sunda), pianggang (Sumatra), dan tenang (Madura).

Lobobasis is a monotypic moth genus in the family Erebidae. Its single species, Lobobasis niveimaculata, is found from the Indian state of Sikkim, Bhutan and Sundaland to Queensland, the Solomon Islands and New Guinea.

The common green bottle fly (Lucilia sericata) is a blow fly found in most areas of the world, and the most well-known of the numerous green bottle fly species. It is 10–14 mm long, slightly larger than a house fly, and has brilliant, metallic, blue-green or golden coloration with black markings.

Macaldenia palumba is a moth of the Noctuidae family. It is found from the Oriental Region of India, Sri Lanka to Japan (Okinawa) and Sundaland, east to New Guinea. It is also found on Guam in Micronesia.
Marumba cristata is a species of moth of the family Sphingidae. It is found from the Himalaya, through Nepal and north-east India, southern and central China to western Malaysia (Sundaland).
Megaloxantha bicolor is a species of metallic wood-boring beetles in the family Buprestidae.
Megistoclisma is a monotypic moth genus of the family Noctuidae erected by George Hampson in 1913. Its only species, Megistoclisma ribbei, was first described by Pagenstecher in 1886.
Miletus symethus, the great brownie, is a small butterfly found in India that belongs to the lycaenids or blues family.
Milothris is a genus of beetle in the family Cerambycidae. Its only species is Milothris marmorea. It was described by Schönherr in 1817.
Monocerotesa proximesta is a moth of the family Geometridae first described by Jeremy Daniel Holloway in 1993. It is found in Borneo.

species.name: Semut Firaun
species.summary: The pharaoh ant (Monomorium pharaonis) is a small (2 mm) yellow or light brown, almost transparent ant notorious for being a major indoor nuisance pest, especially in hospitals.
Monosyntaxis affinis is a moth of the family Erebidae. It was described by Walter Rothschild in 1912. It is found on Peninsular Malaysia and Java.

Mycale grandis, the orange keyhole sponge, is a species of marine demosponge in the family Mycalidae. Mycale is a large genus and this species is placed in the subgenus Mycale making its full name, Mycale (Mycale) grandis.
Mycalesis fuscum, the Malayan bush brown, is a butterfly of the Nymphalidae family. It is found on Peninsular Malaysia, Java, Borneo, and Nias.
Naria miliaris, common name the millet cowry or the inocellate cowry or the military cowry, is a species of sea snail, a cowry, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Cypraeidae, the cowries.

Nausithoe punctata is a species of crown jellyfish in the family Nausithoidae. They are widespread throughout the oceans, and are believed to be ~0.9 to 1.5 centimeters wide with a thick central disk.
Nausithoe racemosa is a species of crown jellyfish in the family Nausithoidae. They are found in the Marshall Islands, and are poisonous.

Nemanthus nitidus, the zebra gorgonian wrapper, is a species of sea anemone within the family Nemanthidae. The species is found in the western Pacific near areas such as Korea, Japan, New Caledonia and the Philippines at depths of 30 to 70 meters. It grows to lengths of 2 to 3 centimeters.

Nembrotha purpureolineata is a species of colourful sea slug, a dorid nudibranch, a marine gastropod mollusc in the family Polyceridae. Nembrotha rutilans, classified as a separate species until 2008, has now been reclassified as Nembrotha purpureolineata.

Neochera inops is a moth in the family Noctuidae. It is found from the north-eastern Himalaya to Sundaland and Palawan, including Bangladesh (Silhet), China (Hainan, Shaanxi, Yunnan), India (Assam, Darjeeling, Tamil Nadu), Indonesia (Borneo), Laos, Malaysia (Labuan, Perak), Myanmar, the Philippines (Balabac, Palawan, M…

Neoscona nautica adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Araneidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1875 oleh L Koch.
Notocrypta feisthamelii, the spotted demon, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae.
Nyctemera hyalina is a moth of the family Erebidae first described by George Thomas Bethune-Baker in 1910. It is found on Sulawesi, Seram, Buru, the Moluccas and in New Guinea.
Olene mendosa (brown tussock moth) is a species of moth found in India, Taiwan, Borneo and Australia.
Pachliopta liris is a species of butterfly from the family Papilionidae that is found on Timor, Wetar Is. and Savu Is.
Papilio tydeus is a species of swallowtail butterfly from the genus Papilio that is found in the Moluccas (Batchian and Gilolo).
Parasa darma is a moth of the family Limacodidae. It is found in Burma, Sundaland, Palawan and Taiwan.

The sailfin flyingfish (Parexocoetus brachypterus) is a member of the flying fish family. Like other members its family, P. brachypterus is known for its ability to leap out of the water and glide above its surface. Its distribution range encompasses the Atlantic, Indian, and Pacific Oceans.
Pediculus humanus is a species of louse that infects humans. It comprises two subspecies:
Pempheris is a genus of sweepers native to the Atlantic, Indian and Pacific Ocean.
Peristernia nassatula is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Fasciolariidae, the spindle snails, the tulip snails and their allies.
Phaedyma shepherdi, the common aeroplane, is a medium sized butterfly of the family Nymphalidae found in Australia.
Phenacovolva pseudogracilis is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusc in the family Ovulidae, the ovulids, cowry allies or false cowries.
Phos roseatus is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusc in the family Nassariidae, the true whelks.
Phyllidia marindica is a species of sea slug, a dorid nudibranch, a shell-less marine gastropod mollusk in the family Phyllidiidae.
Phyllidia polkadotsa is a species of sea slug, a dorid nudibranch, a shell-less marine gastropod mollusk in the family Phyllidiidae.
Phyllodesmium kabiranum is a species of sea slug, an aeolid nudibranch, a marine gastropod mollusc in the family Facelinidae.
Phyllodesmium tuberculatum is a species of sea slug, an aeolid nudibranch, a marine gastropod mollusc in the family Facelinidae.
Pingasa tapungkanana is a moth of the family Geometridae first described by Embrik Strand in 1910. It is found on Sumatra.
Plutodes flavescens is a species of moth of the family Geometridae. It is found in the north-eastern Himalaya and on Borneo, Sumatra and Java.
Pnigomantis medioconstricta common name Indonesian double shield mantis or double shield mantis are the only species in the genus Pnigomantis of mantis of the family Mantidae.

species.name: Rajungan Angin
species.summary: Podophthalmus vigil is a species of swimmer crab found in tropical areas of the Indo-Pacific Ocean, including Hawaii, Japan, South Africa, the Red Sea, Australia. In Australia the crab is found across the north from Exmouth to Moreton Bay.
Polyura moori, the Malayan nawab, is a butterfly found in Asia that belongs to the rajahs and nawabs group (Charaxinae subfamily) of the brush-footed butterflies (Nymphalidae family).
Prosotas aluta, the banded lineblue, is a species of blue butterfly (Lycaenidae) found in Asia. The species was first described by Herbert Druce in 1873.

Pteria penguin, commonly known as the penguin's wing oyster, is a species of marine bivalve mollusc in the family Pteriidae, the pearl oysters. It is native to the western and central Indo-Pacific region and is used for the production of cultured pearls. The generic name comes from Greek πτερον (pteron) meaning wing.
Pterocyclophora huntei is a moth of the family Noctuidae. It is found in Seram, New Guinea, Australia and the Solomon Islands.
Pygospila tyres is a species of moth of the Crambidae family. It is found in the rainforests of south-east Asia, including Hong Kong, India, Thailand and Queensland in Australia.

Rhodactis inchoata, otherwise known as the bullseye mushroom or Tonga blue mushroom, is a species of mushroom coral in the genus Rhodactis, this species is also, but more uncommonly, referred to as the hairy or small elephant ear mushroom.
Saptha beryllitis is a moth in the Choreutidae family. It was described by Meyrick in 1910. It is found on the Nicobar Islands.

Scorpaenopsis obtusa, the shortsnout scorpionfish, is a species of venomous marine ray-finned fish belonging to the family Scorpaenidae, the scorpionfishes. This species is found in the Indo-West Pacific Ocean all the way from Western Australia to Papua New Guinea and then north to Japan.
Scytodes pallida is a species of spitting spider in the family Scytodidae. It was first described by Doleschall in 1859 and has a wide distribution across tropical Asia and the Indo-Pacific region.

Serrognathus titanus is a species of beetle in the family Lucanidae. It was described by Jean Baptiste Boisduval in 1835. Huang and Chen (2013) separated Serognathus from the genus Dorcus by representing morphological characters and DNA analysis.
Sphingnotus mirabilis is a species of beetle belonging to the family Cerambycidae.

Spilarctia arctichroa is a moth in the family Erebidae. It was described by Herbert Druce in 1909. It is found in Papua and north-western Papua New Guinea. The habitat consists of lowland and mountainous areas.

Statilia maculata, common name Asian jumping mantis or "小蟷螂", ko-kamakiri (Japanese meaning "small mantis") or "좀사마귀", joem-sa-ma-gui (Korean meaning "small mantis"), is a species of praying mantis native to Asia that can be found in China and Japan and Korea.

Stenomelania plicaria, commonly known as the chopstick snail or the yellow chopstick snail, is a species of trumpet snail, first described by I. von Born under the synonymized name Helix pilcaria (Index rerum naturalium Musei Cæsarei Vindobonensis (pg. 403)).

Strongylura strongylura, the spottail needlefish or blackspot longtom, is a species of needlefish from the family Belonidae. It is found in the Indian and western Pacific Oceans from the Persian Gulf east to Australia and the Philippines.

Suniana sunias is a butterfly of the Hesperiidae family. It is found in Indonesia (Papua, Maluku), Australia (New South Wales, Northern Territory and Queensland), Papua New Guinea and the Solomon Islands.
Taenaris artemis is a species of butterfly in the family Nymphalidae. It was first described by Samuel Constantinus Snellen van Vollenhoven in 1860. It is found in the Australasian realm
Taenaris macrops, the silky owl, is a butterfly of the Nymphalidae family.
Tajuria mantra, the Felder's royal, is a butterfly in the Lycaenidae family. It is found in Asia.
Talostolida pellucens is a species of sea snail, a cowry, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Cypraeidae, the cowries.

The spider species Tegenaria domestica, commonly known as the barn funnel weaver in North America and the domestic house spider in Europe, is a member of the funnel-web family Agelenidae and a close relative of the hobo spider.
Tetragonus lycaenoides is a moth of the family Callidulidae. It is found in Sulawesi, Borneo, Peninsular Malaysia, Sumatra and Nias.

Theretra alecto, known as the Levant hawk moth, is a moth of the family Sphingidae. It is found in the Indomalaya ecozone and warm parts of the Palearctic ecozone, including extreme south-eastern Europe.
Thorelliola javaensis is a species of jumping spider in the genus Thorelliola that is endemic to Java.
Tosena fasciata is a cicada species from Southeast Asia that has been recorded from Sumatra, Java, Borneo and Ambon Island
Trapania euryeia is a species of sea slug, a dorid nudibranch, a marine gastropod mollusc in the family Goniodorididae.
Trapania toddi is a species of sea slug, a dorid nudibranch, a marine gastropod mollusc in the family Goniodorididae.
Tridrepana olivacea is a moth in the family Drepanidae. It was described by Warren in 1922. It is found in New Guinea, extending to Goodenough Island and the Bismarck Archipelago.
Turris babylonia, common name: the Babylon turrid or tower turrid, is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Turridae, the turrids.
Tutufa rubeta is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Bursidae, the frog shells.
Vanessa dejeanii is a butterfly of the family Nymphalidae found in the Philippines and on Java, Lombok and Bali.
Xanthomelaena is a genus of moths of the family Crambidae. It contains only one species, Xanthomelaena schematias, which is found on Borneo.

Xyleutes persona is a moth of the Cossidae family. It is found in the Indian subregion, Sri Lanka, south-east Asia, Sundaland, Sulawesi, New Guinea and Queensland. The habitat consists of lowland forests.

Actinacantha is a genus of Southeast Asian orb-weaver spiders containing the single species, Actinacantha globulata. It was first described by Eugène Simon in 1864, and has only been found in Indonesia.
Agathiopsis maculata is a moth of the family Geometridae. It is found on New Guinea and Australia (Queensland).
Allopontonia brockii is a small commensal shrimp in the family Palaemonidae.
Allora major, the greater peacock awl, is a butterfly of the family Hesperiidae. It is found as several subspecies in New Guinea and adjacent islands, and on Cape York, Australia.
Amonovula piriei is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Ovulidae, the ovulids, cowry allies or false cowries.
Amphidromus filozonatus is a species of medium-sized air-breathing tree snail, an arboreal gastropod mollusk in the family Camaenidae.
Amphidromus sinistralis, common name the sinistral bulimus, is a species of air-breathing land snail, a terrestrial pulmonate gastropod mollusc in the family Camaenidae....

Amphoraceras is a monotypic moth genus of the family Noctuidae. Its only species, Amphoraceras rothschildi, is found on New Guinea. Both the genus and the species were first described by George Thomas Bethune-Baker in 1904.
Aniculus maximus, the "hairy yellow hermit crab" or "large hairy hermit crab", is an aquatic hermit crab of the family Diogenidae.
Antheraea celebensis is a moth of the family Saturniidae. It is found in Sulawesi and Sundaland.
Anthozela hilaris is a species of moth of the family Tortricidae. It is found on Borneo and in Australia, where it has been recorded from Queensland.
Appias indra, the plain puffin, is a small butterfly of the family Pieridae, that is, the yellows and whites, which is found in India and Southeast Asia.

Appias paulina, the common albatross, Christmas Island white or Ceylon lesser albatross, is a butterfly of the family Pieridae. It is found from India to Samoa, including Indonesia, Japan, Malaysia, New Caledonia, Sri Lanka, Thailand and Australia.

Archigenes aita is a butterfly in the family Riodinidae. It is found on both Sumatra and Borneo. It was first described by British entomologist Lionel de Nicéville in 1893. A phylogenetic analysis led to its being moved out of the genus Abisara.

Arhopala arvina, the purple-brown tailless oakblue, is a species of butterfly belonging to the lycaenid family. It was described by William Chapman Hewitson in 1869. It is found in Southeast Asia (Java, Assam, Burma, Mergui, Thailand, Peninsular Malaya, Sumatra and Borneo).

Ariomma is a genus of deepwater, marine ray-finned fishes belonging to the family Ariommatidae. Members of this genus are found in the Atlantic, Pacific and Indian Oceans. Several members of this genus are of commercial importance as food fish. This genus is currently the only known extant genus in its family.
Artena inversa is a species of moth of the family Erebidae. It is found on Borneo, north-eastern Sumatra and in the Philippines and Peninsular Malaysia.

Asemonea tenuipes is a species of Salticidae (jumping spiders) which can be found on Andaman Islands and in such countries as Burma, India, Sri Lanka, and Thailand. It is commonly referred to as tailed jumper.
Asota dohertyi is a moth of the family Erebidae first described by Walter Rothschild in 1897. It is found on Sulawesi.

Astropecten polyacanthus, bintang laut penyaring pasir atau bintang laut sisir, adalah sebuah bintang laut dari famili Astropectinidae. Spesies tersebut merupakan spesies paling tersebar dalam genus Astropecten, ditemukan di seluruh kawasan Indo-Pasifik. Rentang lengannya berukuran sampai 20 cm (8 in).

Attagenus fasciatus, known generally as banded black carpet beetle, is a species of carpet beetle in the family Dermestidae. Other common names include the tobacco seed beetle and wardrobe beetle. It is found in North America and Oceania.
Atys kuhnsi is a species of small tropical sea snail, a bubble snail, a marine opisthobranch gastropod mollusk in the family Haminoeidae, the haminoea bubble snails.
Baeolidia salaamica, is a species of sea slug, an aeolid nudibranch. It is a marine gastropod mollusc in the family Aeolidiidae.
Bandar pascoei is a species of longhorn beetle native to Asia with a wide range of distribution. The species is a delicacy in Thailand.

Barsine rubricostata is a species of moth of the family Erebidae, subfamily Arctiinae. It is found in Peninsular Malaysia, Sumatra, Borneo. This is a generally rare species ranging from the lowlands to 1,790 meters.
Bastilla fulvotaenia is a moth of the Noctuidae family. It is found from the Indian subregion and Sri Lanka, Taiwan to Lombok, Seram and Buru. Adult is a fruit-piercer.
Bistolida hirundo is a species of sea snail, a cowry, a marine gastropod mollusc in the family Cypraeidae, the cowries.
Biuve fulvipunctata, the white-speckled headshield slug, is a species of sea slug or headshield slug, a marine opisthobranch gastropod mollusc in the family Aglajidae.
Brahmaea celebica is a species of moth of the Brahmaeidae family. It is found on Sulawesi.
Brissus latecarinatus is a species of sea urchins of the Family Brissidae. Their armour is covered with spines. Brissus latecarinatus was first scientifically described in 1778 by Leske.
Bufonaria crumena is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Bursidae, the frog shells.
Calamochrous albipunctalis is a moth in the family Crambidae that is found in Papua New Guinea. It was described by George Hamilton Kenrick in 1907.
Callidula evander adalah spesies ngengat dalam famili Callidulidae. Ngengat ini endemik di Sulawesi.

Calliphara nobilis is a species of insect in the family Scutelleridae (Hemiptera). The larvae live exclusively on the mangrove Excoecaria algallocha, feeding on the developing seeds. Adults are 10–15 millimetres (0.4–0.6 in) long.
Cantikus v-notatus is a species of spider in the family Pholcidae. It is found from Myanmar to Indonesia.
Carminodoris flammea is a species of sea slug, a dorid nudibranch, a marine gastropod mollusc in the family Discodorididae.
Celaenorrhinus ruficornis, the Tamil spotted flat, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae which is found in India.

Cephea cephea, also known as the crown jellyfish, or cauliflower jellyfish, is a species of jellyfish in the family Cepheidae. It occurs in the tropical waters of the western Indo-Pacific to Northern Australia. The species was first described by Peter Forsskål in 1775 and originally given the name Medusa cephea.
Cepora laeta, the Timor gull, is a butterfly in the family Pieridae. It is found on Timor.
The Venus girdle, Cestum veneris, is a comb jelly in the family Cestidae. It is the only member of its genus, Cestum.
Charybdis lucifer, also known as the yellowish-brown crab, is a species of swimming crab in the family Portunidae.
Chicoreus torrefactus, common name the firebrand murex, is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Muricidae, the murex snails or rock snails.
Chikunia nigra, is a species of spider of the genus Chikunia. It is found in Sri Lanka to Taiwan, and Indonesia.
Chromodoris joshi is a species of sea slug. It is a dorid nudibranch, a shell-less marine gastropod mollusc in the family Chromodorididae.
Chromodoris quadricolor is a species of very colourful sea slug, a dorid nudibranch, a marine opisthobranch gastropod mollusc.
Chrysilla acerosa is a species of jumping spider in the family Salticidae. It was first described in 2012 from specimens collected in China.
Chrysoscota vagivitta is a moth of the family Erebidae. It was described by Francis Walker in 1866. It is found on Misool, Seram and New Guinea.
Cinetorhynchus reticulatus is a species of shrimp belonging to the family Rhynchocinetidae, known by the common name green-eye dancing shrimp or reticulated hinge-beak shrimp.
Cirrhochrista brizoalis is a moth of the Crambidae family. It is found across south and south-east Asia from India to Taiwan and New Guinea and in Australia.
Cirrhochrista fumipalpis is a moth in the Crambidae family. It was described by Cajetan Felder, Rudolf Felder and Alois Friedrich Rogenhofer in 1875. It is found on the Moluccas.
Cirrochroa clagia is a species of butterfly of the family Nymphalidae which is found in Indonesia. It was described by Jean-Baptiste Godart in 1823.
Cirrochroa thule, is a species of nymphalid butterfly found in Sulawesi.
Cirrochroa tyche, the common yeoman, is a species of nymphalid butterfly found in forested areas of tropical South Asia and Southeast Asia.
Clanis stenosema is a species of moth of the family Sphingidae first described by Rothschild and Jordan in 1907. It is known from Nias, Sumatra, Java, Borneo and the Philippines.
Claterna is a monotypic moth genus of the family Noctuidae erected by Francis Walker in 1858. Its only species, Claterna cydonia, was first described by Pieter Cramer in 1775.
Coelogorgia is a monotypic genus of corals belonging to the monotypic family Coelogorgiidae. The only species is Coelogorgia palmosa.
Comostola cedilla is a species of moth of the family Geometridae. It is found in New Guinea, Queensland, the southern Moluccas, Sulawesi, the Philippines, Borneo, Sumatra and Peninsular Malaysia.

The white-crowned shama (Copsychus stricklandii) is a medium sized passerine bird in the Old World flycatcher family Muscicapidae. It is endemic to the Southeast Asian island of Borneo. The Maratua shama was formerly treated as a subspecies.
Coryphellina delicata is a species of sea slug, an aeolid nudibranch, a marine gastropod mollusc in the family Flabellinidae.

The Scar Bank gem, (Ctenoplusia limbirena), also known as Silver U-Tail, is a moth of the Noctuidae family. It is found in south-western Europe, Africa (Lesotho, the Cape Province, KwaZulu-Natal, Transvaal, Mozambique, Zimbabwe, Zambia, Botswana, Malawi and eastern and equatorial Africa), the Canary Islands, Arabia, th…
Curetis barsine is a species of butterfly belonging to the lycaenid family. It is found in the Australasian realm.
Cyana inusitata is a moth of the family Erebidae. It was described by George Thomas Bethune-Baker in 1910. It is found in New Guinea.

Cyrtarachne inaequalis adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Araneidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1895 oleh Thorell.

Cyrtodactylus jatnai adalah sejenis cecak jari-lengkung yang menyebar terbatas di Bali Barat, Indonesia. Namanya dalam bahasa Inggris adalah Jatna’s bent-toed gecko. Dalam Bahasa Indonesia cecak ini disebut cecak jari-lengkung jatna (baca: yatna), atau cecak jatna.
Darantasia caerulescens is a moth of the family Erebidae first described by Herbert Druce in 1898. It is found in New Guinea.
Delias battana is a butterfly in the family Pieridae. It was described by Hans Fruhstorfer on 1896. It is endemic to Celebes.
Delias melusina is a butterfly in the family Pieridae. It was described by Otto Staudinger in 1890. It is found in the Australasian realm, where it is endemic to Sulawesi.
Delias nais is a butterfly in the family Pieridae. It was described by Karl Jordan in 1912. It is endemic to New Guinea.
Dercas gobrias is a butterfly in the family Pieridae. It was described by William Chapman Hewitson in 1864. It is found in the Indomalayan realm.
Dermatobranchus tuberculatus is a species of sea slug, a nudibranch, a marine gastropod mollusc in the family Arminidae....
Deroplatys truncata is a species of praying mantis in the genus Deroplatys in the order Mantodea.
Diacamma rugosum, also known as Bornean queenless ant, is a species of ant of the subfamily Ponerinae. It is found from many countries throughout the world. 20 subspecies are recognized.
Diaphania indica, the cucumber moth or cotton caterpillar, is a widespread but mainly Old World moth species. It belongs to the grass moth family, and therein to the large subfamily Spilomelinae.
Dolichoderus sulcaticeps is a species of ant in the genus Dolichoderus. Described by Mayr in 1870, the species is endemic to Borneo, Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand and Vietnam.
Domiporta granatina is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusc in the family Mitridae, the miters or miter snails.
Drupella cornus, common name : the horn drupe, is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Muricidae, the murex snails or rock snails.
Eclogavena quadrimaculata, the four-spotted cowry, is a species of sea snail, a cowry, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Cypraeidae, the cowries.
Eois obliviosa is a moth in the family Geometridae. It is found on Borneo. The habitat consists of lowland forests and lower montane forests.

Episyrphus viridaureus is a species of hoverfly. This hoverfly has orange yellow body with narrow dark bands at the abdomen. The upper side of the thorax covered with black metallic shield and the rest is covered with orange-yellow hair. Between the dark purple eyes, there is a metallic blue part at the fore head.

species.name: Kuda
species.summary: Kuda, jaran, atau aswa (Equus caballus atau Equus ferus caballus) adalah mamalia berkuku ganjil yang telah didomestikasi. Kuda tergolong dalam keluarga taksonomi Equidae dan merupakan salah satu daripada dua subspesies Equus ferus yang masih ada.
Erronea onyx, common name the onyx cowry, is a species of sea snail, a cowry, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Cypraeidae, the cowries.

Euagoras plagiatus is a species of assassin bugs (insects in the family Reduviidae), in the subfamily Harpactorinae. It has been investigated as a potential biocontrol agent for Pterophorus lienigianus Z., which is a pest of eggplant (Solanum melongena).
Euchromia irius is a moth of the subfamily Arctiinae. It was described by Jean Baptiste Boisduval in 1832. It is found on the Moluccas, Aru and New Guinea.

Eudocima homaena is a moth of the family Erebidae. It is found in the Indian subregion, Sri Lanka, Taiwan, Nicobars, Peninsular Malaysia, Borneo, the Philippines and on Christmas Island. It is a major pest on orange plants.
Eudocima iridescens is a moth of the family Erebidae. It is found in large parts of the world, including Australia, New Zealand and Papua New Guinea.
Eurypteryx bhaga is a moth of the family Sphingidae.
Euthalia anosia, the grey baron, is a butterfly of the family Nymphalidae (Limenitidinae). It is found in the Indomalayan realm.
Euthalia whiteheadi is a butterfly of the family Nymphalidae (Limenitidinae). It is found in the Indomalayan realm.
Euthrix laeta is a moth of the family Lasiocampidae first described by Francis Walker in 1855.
Filodes fulvidorsalis is a moth in the Crambidae family. It was described by Geyer in 1832. It is found on Java and Seram.

Gasteracantha audouini adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Araneidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1838 oleh Guérin.
Gasteracantha interrupta is a species of spiny orb-weaver spider in the genus Gasteracantha. It is black and white in color, and it occurs in the Lesser Sundas and Sulawesi in Indonesia.

Glenea elegans adalah spesies kumbang tanduk panjang yang tergolong famili Cerambycidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Glenea, ordo Coleoptera, kelas Insecta, filum Arthropoda, dan kingdom Animalia.
Glyphepithema alapapilionis, common name butterfly-wing sand shell, is a species of predatory sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Naticidae, the moon snails.

Gnoma affinis adalah spesies kumbang tanduk panjang yang tergolong famili Cerambycidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Gnoma, ordo Coleoptera, kelas Insecta, filum Arthropoda, dan kingdom Animalia. Gnoma affinis hanya diketahui hidup di Papua.
Goniobranchus conchyliatus is a species of colourful sea slug, a dorid nudibranch, a marine gastropod mollusc in the family Chromodorididae.
Gonodactylaceus falcatus, otherwise referred to as the Philippine mantis shrimp, is a large stomatopod found throughout the Indo-Pacific.
Gonodactylus chiragra is a medium to large mantis shrimp that is distributed widely throughout the West Indo-Pacific.
Graphium cloanthus, the glassy bluebottle, is a common, non-threatened tropical butterfly of the family Papilionidae.
Graphium thule is a species of butterfly in the family Papilionidae. It is found in New Guinea. The larva feeds on Aquifoliacene ilex.
Graphium wallacei is a butterfly found in New Guinea and the Moluccas that belongs to the swallowtail family.
Gyrineum lacunatum is a species of predatory sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusc in the family Ranellidae, the triton snails, triton shells or tritons.
Habrona brunnea is a moth in the family Drepanidae. It is found in New Guinea and on the Moluccas. The habitat consists of mountainous areas.
Habuprionovolva aenigma is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Ovulidae, the ovulids, cowry allies or false cowries.
Habuprionovolva basilia is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Ovulidae, the ovulids, cowry allies or false cowries.

Haematobia irritans, the horn fly, is a small fly (about half the size of a common housefly) described by Linnaeus in 1758. It is of the genus Haematobia which is the European genus of bloodsucking flies.
Hamadruas hieroglyphica is a species of lynx spider in the family Oxyopidae. It was originally described by Tamerlan Thorell in 1887 as Oxyopes hieroglyphicus.

Hamodes propitia is a moth in the family Erebidae first described by Félix Édouard Guérin-Méneville in 1831. It is found in the north-eastern Himalayas, Myanmar, Thailand, Borneo, Sumatra, Taiwan, from the Philippines east to Queensland, the Carolines (Palau) and the Solomon Islands.
Harpa amouretta, common name the lesser harp, is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Harpidae, the harp snails.
Harpa articularis, common name the articulate harp shell, is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Harpidae, the harp snails.
Hastula acumen is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Terebridae, the auger snails.
Hemithea marina is a moth of the family Geometridae first described by Arthur Gardiner Butler in 1878. It is found in the Indian subregion, Sri Lanka to Japan, Sundaland, Taiwan, Sulawesi and Seram.
Herochroma urapteraria is a moth of the family Geometridae. It is found in Sundaland. The habitat consists of lower and upper montane forests.
Heterocnephes scapulalis is a moth of the family Crambidae. It is found on Ambon, Peninsular Malaysia and New Guinea.

Hexamitoptera is a monotypic moth genus in the family Erebidae. Its only species, Hexamitoptera lawinda, is found in Indonesia (Nias, Sumatra), Peninsular Malaysia and Borneo. The habitat consists of lowland dipterocarp forests. Both the genus and the species were first described by Pagenstecher in 1885.
Hippocampus satomiae atau kuda laut kerdil satomi adalah salah satu kuda laut terkecil yang dikenal di dunia dengan panjang rata-rata 13,8 mm dan panjang sekitar 11,5 mm.

Hippotion rafflesii, the Raffles' striated hawkmoth, is a moth of the family Sphingidae. It is known from Sri Lanka, southern and eastern India, Nepal, Myanmar, Thailand, southern China, Malaysia (Peninsular), Indonesia (Sumatra, Java, Sulawesi) and the Philippines.

The Lantana Defoliator (Hypena laceratalis) is a moth of the Noctuidae family. It is native to Africa (where it is known from Kenya, Socotra, Madagascar, Mascarenes) to Yemen and India, but was deliberately introduced to Australia (where it now known from northern Queensland to Kempsey in New South Wales) via Hawaii in…
Hypochrosis sternaria is a moth of the family Geometridae first described by Achille Guenée in 1857. It is found from India through Southeast Asia to Sumatra and Borneo.

The Dussumier's halfbeak (Hyporhamphus dussumieri) lives in reefs and shallow lagoons. They live solitary or in groups, and are often seen circling snorkelers, just under the surface of the water. The longest known specimen was 38.0 cm in length.

Hypospila bolinoides is a species of moth in the family Erebidae. The species is found from the Indo-Australian tropics of India, Sri Lanka, Myanmar, Andaman Islands, China north to Japan and east to New Guinea, Queensland and the Carolines.

Hypothenenus hampei adalah hama yang menyerang tanaman kopi di seluruh dunia. hama ini berasal dari Afrika. Hama ini menyerang biji kopi, menyebabkan lubang pada bagian ostiole dan serbuk sisa makanan dapat terlihat disana. Hama ini menyerang buah yang sudah hijau, matang, dan kering.
The Rusty Plum Aphid, (Hysteroneura setariae), is an aphid in the superfamily Aphidoidea in the order Hemiptera. It is a true bug and sucks sap from plants.
